declarations.evidence: RHONÉA PUBLISHES A COMPLETE, PROPERLY STRUCTURED DECLARATION — FOR THE VINTAGE AFTER OURS. Rhonéa (CVR, 228 route de Carpentras, 84190 Beaumes-de-Venise), the Vacqueyras/Beaumes-de-Venise cooperative group; Systembolaget's supplier is Vintedge AB and the producer field is Rhonéa, which matches. THE FIRST FRENCH PRODUCER IN THIS PROJECT TO PUBLISH AN INGREDIENT LIST AT ALL. It sits inline on the PrestaShop product page under a heading 'Ingrédients / Nutrition' — a 'bloc_ingnutri' div in the server's HTML, no JavaScript, no vendor platform — with an Ingrédients paragraph and a 'Déclaration nutritionnelle' table per 100 ml (Energie kJ and kcal, Matières grasses, dont acides gras saturés, Glucides, dont sucres, Protéines, Sel). That is the full mandated set. THE PRODUCT PAGE STATES ITS OWN VINTAGE IN THE HEADING, AND IT IS 2025 FOR BOTH OF OUR WINES, where Systembolaget's bottles are 2024. Its 'Le millésime' paragraph confirms it independently ('2025 est un millésime précoce et contrasté…'). PrestaShop keeps one product per cuvée and edits it forward, so there is no 2024 page on the shop and no per-vintage archive. AND THE PRODUCER'S OWN PER-VINTAGE CHANNEL, WHICH DOES COVER OUR 2024, CARRIES NO INGREDIENT LIST. Rhonéa runs a QR platform on its own subdomain, m.rhonea.fr, one short code per wine per vintage, server-rendered, with a language selector and a vintage switcher. https://m.rhonea.fr/M723LF IS 'Passe Colline, AOC Ventoux, Rouge, 2024' — our exact wine and vintage, in French, published by CVR at Beaumes-de-Venise. Its whole content is Présentation, Le millésime, Terroir, Vinification, Cépages (Carignan, Grenache noir, Syrah), Spécifications ('Sucre résiduel : inferieur à 2 g/l. Contient des sulfites.'), Service, Dégustation and Accords gourmands. NO INGREDIENT LIST AND NO NUTRITION TABLE — the sulphite line is an allergen statement. Its downloadable fiche produit PDF was fetched and extracted and repeats exactly the same fields and nothing more. So the 2024 has a per-vintage disclosure page without a declaration, and the 2025 has a declaration without being our bottle. Attaching the 2025 list to the 2024 bottle is precisely the substitution the vintage rule forbids, and the two cuvées' lists differ from each other in their stabilisers, which is direct evidence that these lists are formulated per wine rather than boilerplate. FR (EU) pages used throughout; a /gb/ mirror exists and was not used. THE 2025 RED'S LIST, RECORDED HERE ONLY AS EVIDENCE OF WHAT WAS SEEN AND NOT ATTACHED TO THIS BOTTLE, READS: 'Raisins, Conservateurs & antioxydants (Sulfites, Acide L-ascorbique), Agent Stabilisateurs (Gomme arabique, Polyaspartate de potassium), Mise en bouteille sous atmosphère protectrice', with 328 kJ / 79 kcal per 100 ml, glucides 0,9 g dont sucres 0,2 g. Cépages on the 2025 are Grenache noir 45 %, Syrah 40 %, Carignan 15 %, where the 2024 QR page lists Carignan, Grenache noir, Syrah — a further sign the two vintages are not interchangeable.

It runs a WooCommerce marketing site (cave-tavel-lirac.fr) and a separate Shopify boutique (boutique.cave-tavel-lirac.fr), and BOTH ARE SERVER-RENDERED, so a negative here is a real observation. THIS WAS THE STRONGEST-POSITIONED FRENCH PRODUCER OF THE BATCH AND IT STILL PUBLISHES NOTHING. Both Swedish bottles are the 2025, which is the current release; the Shopify shop sells both cuvées AT EXACTLY THAT VINTAGE ('TAVEL Trésor des sables 2025' and 'TAVEL Cuvée Royale 2025' in the H1 and 'Millésime : 2025' in the meta description); and the shop even keeps separate products per vintage where it matters, so it is structurally capable of a per-vintage declaration. BOTH PRODUCT PAGES RETURN ZERO HITS for ingrédient, nutrition, allergène, sulfite, kcal, énergie and conservateur. The Shopify store's complete page sitemap is seven administrative pages with no ingredients or e-label page among them, and the only non-Shopify hosts referenced anywhere on a product page are judge.me, PayPal and Google Fonts — there is no QR platform and no e-label vendor. The WooCommerce site's own product page for Trésor des Sables is a stale 2022 with the same fields and no list, and its 'Télécharger la fiche produit' is FICHE-TAVEL-TRESOR-DES-SABLES-fr.pdf under /wp-content/uploads/2018/07/ — a 2018 upload, predating the obligation entirely, so it was deliberately NOT fetched. FR (EU) pages used; /en/ and 简体中文 mirrors exist. The comparison with Rhonéa in the same batch is the point: two Rhône cooperative groups of similar size and similar e-commerce sophistication, one publishing the full mandated set inline and the other publishing nothing at all.

declarations.name: Turckheim Pinot Gris Réserve
declarations.evidence: THE FIRST THIRD-PARTY E-LABEL PLATFORM FOUND ON A FRENCH PRODUCER'S PAGE, AND THE FIRST GS1 DIGITAL LINK IN THIS PROJECT — AND OUR BOTTLE IS A VINTAGE AHEAD OF IT. Cave Vinicole de Turckheim, 16 rue des Tuileries, 68230 Turckheim, the Alsace cooperative; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Cave de Turckheim' and the supplier is Nigab, so the producer matches. Its PrestaShop site puts a button labelled 'INGREDIENTS ET NUTRITION' at the foot of each product page, linking to https://alliance-alsace.com/01/{GTIN}/22/{variant} — a GS1 Digital Link URI (AI 01 = GTIN, AI 22 = consumer product variant) on a platform that titles itself 'Alliance Nutri'. The page is plain server-rendered HTML, about 6 kB, with an 11-language EU selector (Francais, English, Italiano, Dansk, Deutsch, Espanol, Suomalainen, Nederlands, Portugues, Romana, Svenska) driven by a POST, and it also honours the Accept-Language request header, which is how the French text below was read. IT IDENTIFIES ITSELF AS WELL AS WINESTRO DOES: designation, sweetness, vintage, format and Gencode are all on the page. AND WHAT IT SAYS IS 2024. 'Denomination: PINOT GRIS 2024 AOP ALSACE RESERVE / Sucrosite : DEMI-SEC / Millesime : 2024 / Format : 75cL / Gencode : 03274550732866'. Systembolaget 211901 is the 2025 at 12,5 %; the producer's own product page agrees with its e-label at 'Millesime : 2024' and 13 degrees. The shop keeps exactly one product per grape in the Reserve range and edits it forward, so there is no 2025 page and no 2025 e-label link. The bare GS1 root /01/03274550732866 returns 404, so the variant segment (008859) is required and there is no way to reach a 2025 variant without guessing it, which the rules forbid. THE 2024'S LIST, RECORDED ONLY AS EVIDENCE AND NOT ATTACHED, in French: 'Raisins, mout de raisins concentre, sucre, conservateur (SULFITES), regulateur d'acidite (acide tartrique [L(+)-]), agent stabilisateur (contient acide metatartrique et/ou mannoproteines de levures). Mis en bouteille sous atmosphere protectrice.' Nutrition per 100 ml: 330 kJ / 80 kcal, fats 0 g of which saturates 0 g, carbohydrate 1,8 g of which sugars 1,1 g, protein 0 g, salt 0 g. Note that it declares concentrated grape must and sugar — a chaptalised Alsace wine — which is exactly the kind of per-vintage detail that cannot be carried across a vintage boundary. FR (EU) reading used; an English default and a Svenska option exist.
declarations.note: Alliance Nutri (alliance-alsace.com) is a shared Alsace platform and is the best French lead this project has: look for the same 'INGREDIENTS ET NUTRITION' button on other Alsace cooperatives.

declarations.name: Pfaff Black Tie Riesling Pinot Gris
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT BOTTLE IS ON THE COOPERATIVE'S OWN SHOP, CONFIRMED ON FOUR FIELDS, AND THERE IS NO DECLARATION ON IT. Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim (Pfaff), the Alsace cooperative; Systembolaget's producer field is 'La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim', supplier Amka Vinimport AB. The shop product page is headed 'Black Tie by Pfaff A.O.P. Alsace SEC 2024' with 'Cepage Riesling/Pinot Gris', 'Degre d'alcool alc 12,5% vol.' and '75cl Bouteille' in its title — producer, cuvee, vintage, grape blend, strength and pack all match Systembolaget 7623701 (2024, 12,5 %, 750 ml) exactly. This is the strongest identity match of the batch and it makes the negative a real one. THE PAGE CONTAINS NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE AND NOT EVEN A SULPHITE STATEMENT: zero hits for ingr, nutri, sulfit, allerg and kcal in the raw HTML. Its content is Cepage, Degre, Terroir, Vendange, Vinification, Degustation, Accords Gourmands, Service — a tasting note with a vinification paragraph. The only off-site links on the whole page are info-calories-alcool.org (the French drinks industry's generic per-category calorie calculator, already recorded as a decoy), Facebook, the agency vinium.com and Google's policy pages. There is no QR platform and no e-label vendor. NOTE THE CONTRAST WITH CAVE DE TURCKHEIM IN THE SAME BATCH: another Alsace cooperative of similar size links a full GS1 Digital Link e-label from every product page. Alliance Nutri is therefore NOT a shared Alsace platform that every cooperative in the region uses — Pfaffenheim references it nowhere. TWO RENDERING FACTS WORTH KEEPING: the marketing site's /nos_vins/ pages are an AJAX shell (the Vinium framework; only the <title> is server-rendered) while the /fr/boutique/ and /fr/produit/ shop pages are fully server-rendered, so on this platform the shop is the readable surface and the marketing site is not. And the sitemap keeps ONE MARKETING PAGE PER VINTAGE for each cuvee, 2020 to 2024, which would have made this an ideal vintage match had the pages carried anything. FR (EU) pages used throughout.

declarations.evidence: AN EXPORT BRAND WITH NO PAGE ON ITS OWN PRODUCER'S SITE — the Saget la Perriere pattern, on a cooperative. Cellier des Dauphins is the brand of the Union des Vignerons des Cotes du Rhone, a union of Rhone cooperatives; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Cellier des Dauphins' and the supplier is Solera Sweden AB. 'Les Dauphins' is a separate export range of the same group and IT DOES NOT APPEAR ANYWHERE ON THE PRODUCER'S CURRENT SITE. The whole site is 29 pages by its own sitemap, the ranges are Reserve, Prestige, Carnet d'Invitation and Signature, and the English URL that search engines still index for precisely this wine, /en/our-sunny-wines/our-ranges/les-dauphins/les-dauphins-organic/, now returns 404 with the /en/ tree gone from the sitemap index. Every other page a search finds for 'Les Dauphins Organic' is a foreign retailer — vivino, wine.com, saratogawine, agedcork — and a retailer's transcription is not a source. Its own organic Cotes du Rhone red, Signature Cotes du Rhone Bio Rouge — the same appellation, the same colour, the same organic certification, plausibly the same liquid under a different label, and deliberately NOT used as a substitute — returns zero hits for ingr, nutri, sulfit, allerg, kcal and energie in 89 kB of server-rendered HTML. declarations.name: Quatre Tours Aix en Provence Rosé
declarations.evidence: A NUXT SINGLE-PAGE APPLICATION THAT DECLARES ITS OWN UNREADABILITY, AND A SITEMAP WITH NO WINE IN IT. Les Quatre Tours, 56 avenue de la Grande-Begude, 13770 Venelles, the Coteaux d'Aix-en-Provence cooperative founded in 1924 by four Venelles growers, 300 ha across five villages, about 1,6 million bottles; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Les Quatre Tours' and the supplier is Stellan Kramer AB. Every page on quatretours.com returns the same 2 kB shell whose inline state object reads literally serverRendered:false with an empty <div id="__nuxt">, so no product content is in any server response and none can be. That is a rendering limit, not a refusal and not a finding about the producer. THE SITEMAP MAKES THE SEARCH SHORTER THAN THE RENDERING PROBLEM WOULD: it lists 29 URLs and every one is a static page in the French or the English mirror. There is no /nos-vins/{cuvee} route, no product route, and therefore no page for the Aix en Provence Rose 2025 to be found on even if the site rendered. The old domain les4tours.com does not resolve at all. WORTH RECORDING AGAINST THIS PRODUCER: Systembolaget already carries a DECLARED wine from it — 215801, Domaine de Collavery 2025, declaration_status 'declared' in our own dataset — so this cooperative demonstrably supplies an ingredient declaration to its Swedish importer while publishing none on the web. That is direct evidence for the distinction this file exists to keep: 'not found' means not found by a crawler, and here the same producer's declaration reached Systembolaget through the trade channel and not through its own site.

declarations.evidence: THE PRODUCER'S MARKETING SITE CARRIES NO LIST AND ITS WEBSHOP GEOBLOCKS US — the first geoblock in this project. Maison Gustave Lorentz, Bergheim, Alsace; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Gustave Lorentz' and the supplier is Ward Wines AB. The marketing site www.gustavelorentz.com is server-rendered WordPress and readable in full, and its wines live on RANGE pages rather than per-wine pages: its own sitemap holds 63 URLs across three language mirrors and not one of them is a single wine. All three range pages that between them cover our three Swedish bottles were fetched and return ZERO hits for ingr, nutri, sulfit, allerg, kcal and alliance — they are tasting notes with a paragraph of terroir, and they state no vintage, so even a list on them could not have been vintage-matched. EVERY WINE LINKS OUT TO boutique.gustavelorentz.com, AND THAT HOST ANSWERS HTTP 403 WITH THE BODY 'This website is only authorised from France and Germany'. It refuses robots.txt itself at the same status. That is a technological measure and under this project's rules it is absolute: the refusal was accepted at the first request, no product page was attempted, and nothing was done to work around it. So it cannot be established whether the shop carries a declaration; what can be established is that a reader in Sweden holding this bottle cannot reach it either. OUR WINE IS IN THAT SHOP'S CATALOGUE under /fr/cuvees-decouvertes/3-crustaces-2016.html, named from the marketing site's own link — recorded so a future run from an eligible country can go straight to it. NOTE THE SLUG'S VINTAGE IS STALE (2016), the PrestaShop trap already documented for Bunan and Rhonea; it says nothing about which vintage the page now shows. COMPARE CAVE DE TURCKHEIM IN THE SAME BATCH: another Alsace house whose PrestaShop links a full GS1 Digital Link e-label from every product page. Alliance Nutri is referenced nowhere on Lorentz's readable pages.

declarations.name: Hugel Gentil
declarations.evidence: A COMPLETE, PER-VINTAGE, LOT-NUMBERED E-LABEL FOR OUR EXACT BOTTLE, REJECTED ON STRENGTH ALONE. Famille Hugel, 3 rue de la premiere Armee, 68340 Riquewihr; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Hugel' and the supplier is Lively Wines Sweden AB. The disclosure page is headed 'Famille Hugel, Gentil, AOC Alsace, Blanc, 2024' and reads 'Lot No. : L.CFCN D | Alc. 12 % vol.' and 'Bottle (75 cl)'. Producer, cuvee, appellation, colour, vintage and pack all match Systembolaget 210801 exactly. WHAT IT DECLARES: 'Ingredients: Grapes, Sulphites , Carboxymethyl cellulose'. Nutrition per 100 ml — Energy 328 kJ / 79 kcal, Fat 0 g of which saturates 0 g, Carbohydrate 0,09 g of which sugars 0,09 g, Protein NC, Salt NC (also given per 125 ml). That is the full mandated set. IT IS NOT ATTACHED BECAUSE OF THE ALCOHOL. The e-label's labelled strength is 12 % vol and Systembolaget's record is 13,0 % — one full percentage point, twice the 0,5 % vol EU labelling tolerance. Under the rule already applied to Sebastian Erbeldinger, a declaration that contradicts the shelf record on strength by more than the tolerance cannot describe the same fill and must not be attached, and that weighs heavier here because a record in this file outranks Systembolaget's own text. THE PAGE IS ALSO LOT-SPECIFIC — 'Lot No. : L.CFCN D' — so it is a disclosure for one bottling run, and a Swedish allocation bottled as another lot would have its own. That is a second, independent reason the identity is not certain. THE DISCREPANCY IS NOT SYSTEMATIC AND SO CANNOT BE EXPLAINED AWAY: across Hugel's three Swedish 2024s, Systembolaget says 13,0 / 12,0 / 13,0 and Hugel's own labels say 12 / 12 / 14 — one agrees exactly and the other two are 1,0 pp out in OPPOSITE directions. If the owner decides Systembolaget's per-vintage alcohol field is unreliable, this wine and the Pinot Gris Classic are the two to revisit first; that is a decision about the rule, not one this run should take. THE PLATFORM: Famille Hugel's QR destination is m.hugel.com, which is VINCOD — the same vendor as m.rhonea.fr, now identified: the pages load images from cdn.vin.co and every short code is mirrored at vincod.com/{code}, so the vendor is vin.co, one of the French e-label names this project had listed as 'still unseen in the wild'. It is now seen. Its robots.txt on m.hugel.com is byte-for-byte the same shape as m.rhonea.fr's: a long bad-bot blocklist ending in Disallow: /, then a separate 'User-agent: *' group disallowing only /ajax, /admin, /manage, /create, /superadmin and /*/get/{qrcode,tablecard,embed}$. We are in none of the named groups and every page read here is allowed, so NO robots exception was needed or used. Everything is server-rendered plain HTML. declarations.name: Mr. Paul Rosé
declarations.evidence: A GROWER GROUP WITH A REAL WEBSHOP, AND ITS PRODUCT PAGES CARRY NEITHER A DECLARATION NOR A VINTAGE. Vignerons Proprietes Associes, Rue Emile Bilhau, 30510 Generac — a 1994 association of 20 chateaux and estates across nine appellations, three winemaking sites; Systembolaget's producer field is 'Vignerons Proprietes Associes' and the supplier is Ex Terra Wines AB. This is the fifth cooperative-shaped producer of the batch and it fails the same way the small estates did. TWO PRODUCT PAGES WERE READ, ONE FROM EACH OF OUR TWO BRANDS, and both return ZERO hits for ingr, nutri, sulfit, allerg and kcal in 198 kB of server-rendered HTML. What the template holds is Terroir, Cepage, Vinification, Degustation and Conservation — a tasting note, with a price and an add-to-cart button. THE DECISIVE FACT IS THE MISSING VINTAGE. Neither page states one anywhere: the only four-digit years in the whole of chapitre-3 are WordPress's own article:modified_time and dateModified metadata (2024-07-02), and the catalogue is organised one product per colour and format — three Mr Paul products, four Chapitre products — rather than one per bottling. Under the rule already recorded for Denis Pere & Fils, Barraud and Vigneau-Chevreau, AN UNDATED CUVEE PAGE CANNOT BE MATCHED TO A BOTTLING however much text it carries, so this producer could not have yielded an attachable record even if a list appeared tomorrow. That is worth saying precisely because the site is otherwise well built. Also checked and absent: no QR platform, no vin.co or Vincod short code, no alliance-alsace link, no e-label vendor of any kind. FR (EU) pages used; an /en/ mirror exists and was not used. Systembolaget's bottle is the ROSE; the page read here, mr-paul-2, is the red ('D'une couleur pourpre avec des reflets vifs', 100 % Grenache). One of the other two Mr Paul products is presumably the rose, and it was deliberately not opened: all three share one template, none is dated, and opening more pages on a small estate's server to confirm an absence the template already settles is exactly the walking this project does not do.

declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT BOTTLE IS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SHOP, AT OUR VINTAGE, AND THERE IS NO INGREDIENT LIST ANYWHERE ON IT. Vins d'Alsace Dopff & Irion, Riquewihr; Systembolaget 217301, supplier Solera Sweden AB. The product page is headed 'Riesling Cuvee Rene Dopff A.O.P. Alsace 2024', sold as 6 x 75 cl, and states 'alc 12.5% vol.' against Systembolaget's 12,0 — 0,5 pp, at the EU labelling tolerance and not beyond it, so the identity is not in doubt. Producer, cuvee, vintage and pack all match. WHAT THE PAGE CARRIES INSTEAD OF A DECLARATION: Cepage, Vendange, Service, Conservation, Vinification, Degustation, Accords Gourmands — a tasting note — plus three pictograms in a block the CSS calls '_legal': the pregnant-woman warning, an ecoemballages mark and a SULFITES icon. An allergen pictogram is not an ingredient list and there is no nutrition table and no energy value. THE PER-VINTAGE FICHE PDF IS THE SAME NON-DECLARATION AS THE REST OF FRANCE. Its slug carries the vintage (…-2024-260.pdf), it was fetched once and its text extracted in full, and it holds exactly the fields already on the page: cepage, degre d'alcool, vendange, service, conservation, vinification, degustation, accords. No substances, no kcal. This is the fiche technique pattern this project has now seen at Revelette, Astros, Gerard Bertrand and Clos Cibonne. NO PLATFORM IS LINKED. The page's outbound links are Facebook, Instagram, a share widget, ecoemballages and info-calories-alcool.org — the French drinks industry's per-CATEGORY calorie calculator, already recorded here as looking like compliance and not being it. No m. subdomain, no vincod.com short code, no alliance-alsace.com GS1 URL, no u-label, nothing. THE PLATFORM IS VINIUM, the same framework as La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim ('Creation Vinium' in the footer), and that is not a coincidence: Dopff & Irion belongs to the Pfaffenheim group. Pfaffenheim was probed in the previous batch and publishes no list either, so this is one owner failing twice rather than two independent observations. ONE USEFUL DIFFERENCE FROM PFAFFENHEIM: there the /fr/nos_vins/ marketing pages render client-side and only the shop was readable. Here the marketing URL simply redirects into the shop, so the whole Vinium deployment is server-rendered and 'no declaration' is a real observation and not a rendering artefact. FR (EU) pages used throughout; an /en/ mirror exists and was not needed.

declarations.evidence: THE BEST-DOCUMENTED FRENCH WINE IN THIS BATCH AND STILL NOT A DECLARATION. Domaine Etienne Simonis, 2 rue des Moulins, 68770 Ammerschwihr — Ecocert organic and Demeter biodynamic; Systembolaget 7838201, supplier RekoVin Sverige AB. IDENTITY IS EXACT: the product page is headed '2024 Vin d'Alsace Riesling Les Moulins' and the fiche PDF repeats 'Vin d'Alsace Riesling / Les Moulins / 2024' over the estate's own address. Producer, cuvee, vintage and 75 cl pack all match, and the estate's organic status matches Systembolaget's organic flag. Alcohol on the fiche is 12,5 % vol against Systembolaget's 13,0 — 0,5 pp, at the EU labelling tolerance and not beyond it. WHAT THE FICHE ACTUALLY CONTAINS: appellation, cepage (100 % riesling), origine, terroir, vine age, planting density, SUCRES 0.37 g/l, ACIDITE 3,85 g H2SO4/l, ALCOOL 12,5 % vol, sweetness scale and cellaring — an analysis sheet. NO INGREDIENT LIST AND NO ENERGY VALUE. THE NEAR-MISS HERE IS A NEW SHAPE AND WORTH NAMING: the vinification paragraph reads 'ce vin d'Alsace Riesling est elabore SANS LEVURAGE, SANS COLLAGE, SANS CHAPTALISATION NI ACIDIFICATION', and the vine paragraph says only sulphur, copper and plant teas are used in the vineyard. That is a statement of what was NOT added, in prose, on the vineyard and cellar practice — it is the negative of an ingredient list and it is not one. A wine made without fining agents still has to declare what it does contain, starting with the sulphites. Under the agent's rules a producer page counts only where it presents an actual list of substances. THE PRODUCT PAGE ITSELF RETURNS ZERO for ingr, nutri, kcal, kJ, allerg, sulfit, valeur, energ, etiquet, QR, vincod and alliance across 29 kB of raw HTML, and the estate's own plan du site lists 22 pages with no e-label page among them. NO PLATFORM IS LINKED. TWO THINGS FOR THE NEXT RUN. (1) The ?pdf endpoint is a Soluxa-built generator, and its output is MALFORMED: no %%EOF marker, so pypdf refuses it until five bytes of leading whitespace are stripped and '%%EOF' appended — that is a broken generator, not a protected document. It also serves over HTTP/2 truncated (curl exit 92); --http1.1 returned the whole 450 kB. (2) The fiche's footer prints www.domaine-simonis.fr, WHICH DOES NOT RESOLVE — a producer's own document can name a dead domain, and that is not a second site to go looking for. declarations.name: Luc Faller Pétillant Naturel Muscat
declarations.evidence: THE PRODUCER HAS NO WEBSITE, WHICH IS THE END OF THE TRAIL AND NOT A REASON TO KEEP LOOKING. E.A.R.L. Vignoble Luc Faller, 51 route des Vins, 67140 Itterswiller — 8,3 ha, Ecocert organic since 2009 and Demeter biodynamic, run by Luc and Myriam Faller; Systembolaget 5842001, supplier RekoVin Sverige AB, organic flag set, which matches. Six plausible domains were checked BY DNS ONLY and none resolves; the two directories that would carry a website field if there were one — the Vignerons Independants federation, of which the estate is a member, and the official Route des Vins d'Alsace — list none; and every page a search returns for the estate is a retailer, a guide or a certification register. The estate's only first-party web presence is a Facebook page. UNDER THE PROJECT'S RULES THERE IS NOTHING TO FETCH: a declaration may only come from an e-label or the producer's own site, and a retailer's transcription in another country has worse provenance than Systembolaget's. avenuedesvins.fr sells this exact wine and its listing was not used as a source, exactly as vinello.eu was not used for La Petite Perriere. THE SISTER-ESTATE TRAP WAS WALKED INTO AND STOPPED AT THE DOOR, AND IT IS WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE IT IS A GOOD ONE: vins-faller.fr resolves and serves a complete estate site with an online shop — and it is DOMAINE ANDRE FALLER, 2 route du Vin, 67140 ITTERSWILLER. Same surname, SAME VILLAGE, different street, different estate. Nothing on it may be attached to this wine, and a run in a hurry would have attached it. This is the Erbeldinger and Drathen rule in its purest form. 'Not found' here means the crawler found nothing. The bottle carries whatever it carries, and a QR code that is never linked from the web is invisible to this project — the estate may well have printed one.

declarations.name: Grand Sud Rosé
declarations.evidence: THE BRAND OWNER IS REACHABLE, THE BRAND SITE IS FROM 2012, AND THE ONLY INGREDIENT LISTS IN CIRCULATION ARE ON SOURCES THIS PROJECT MAY NOT USE. Les Grands Chais de France, Petersbach, Bas-Rhin — France's largest wine exporter, 1,3 bn EUR turnover, 80 % exported; Systembolaget's supplier for all four Grand Sud items is Derivino AB. GCF IS AN ALSACE COMPANY, which is why it was taken after the Alsace estate pool was exhausted: the working hypothesis from batch 3c is that platform adoption, not producer shape, predicts a French declaration, and both French platforms found so far are Alsatian. IT DOES NOT HOLD HERE. The group's corporate site is a small brochure — 38 URLs, one page per brand — and the Grand Sud page is a paragraph of copy whose single outbound link is http://www.grandsud-wines.com. THE BRAND SITE IS A DEAD ARTEFACT: WordPress with sitepress 2.4.3, flickr-mini-gallery and a joliprint button, and its own page metadata dates it 12 June 2012. Every URL on it redirects to a JavaScript country-and-age gate. A site last touched a decade before the obligation was not going to carry an e-label, and no vendor host is referenced anywhere on either site — no vincod.com, no alliance-alsace.com, no u-label, no m. subdomain (m.grandsud.fr resolves, but so does randomxyz123.grandsud.fr: it is wildcard DNS on an unrelated IPv6 host, not the Vincod pattern). AND THIS IS THE CLEAREST CASE YET OF THE TRAP THE RULES EXIST FOR. A full ingredient list for Grand Sud Chardonnay is in wide circulation — 'raisins, mouts concentres, sulfites, sorbate de potassium, acide tartrique, acide malique, gomme arabique, carboxymethylcellulose' — and every place it appears is a place this project may not take it from: Carrefour, Openfoodfacts, a Belgian wholesaler's tech sheet, vinello.eu. It is almost certainly right. IT IS NOT RECORDED, because a retailer's or a crowd database's transcription has worse provenance than Systembolaget's own, its vintage is unstated and its market and pack are unverified — and a record in this file OUTRANKS Systembolaget's text, so attaching an unsourced list here would override a correct absence with an unverifiable presence. This is the vinello.eu rule from the Saget la Perriere record, met again and refused again. PACK MATTERS HERE MORE THAN USUAL. Systembolaget's four Grand Sud items are four different fills — 250 ml, 1 L, and two 3 L bag-in-boxes — and an e-label is a per-pack disclosure. Even a genuine producer list for the 1 L bottle would not have carried to the BiB without the producer saying so. THIS RECORD IS THE 1 L ITEM.

declarations.name: Chassagne Montrachet Premier Cru Cru Morgeots Roug Marc Morey
declarations.evidence: SIX WINES, ONE PRODUCER, AND A SITE WITH NO PER-WINE PAGE AT ALL. Domaine Marc Morey & Fils, Chassagne-Montrachet — founded 1919, 9 ha, now run by Sabine Mollard, the founder's great-granddaughter; Systembolaget's six 2024 bottlings all come through Vinitor AB. The estate's live site is domaine-marc-morey.fr; domaine-marc-morey.com is a Gandi parking page and is not it. THE SITEMAP SETTLES THE PRODUCER IN TWO REQUESTS, which is the cheapest possible outcome and the reason it is worth recording precisely. Seventeen URLs, and the wine content is organised BY COLOUR, BY GRAPE AND BY APPELLATION — /vins-blancs, /vins-rouges, /chardonnay, /aligote, /pinot-noir, /nos-appellations — never by bottling. There is no Batard-Montrachet page, no Caillerets page, no Chenevottes page, no En Virondot page. Our six cuvees do not have URLs. THE RANGE PAGE CARRIES NOTHING EITHER: 179 kB of server-rendered HTML returning ZERO for ingr, nutri, kcal, allerg, sulfit, millesime, vincod, alliance, e-label and etiquette. It is a hospitality page — terroir, tasting language, an invitation to visit the domaine — the exact French small-estate profile already recorded for Denis Pere & Fils, Barraud and Vigneau-Chevreau. AND IT STATES NO VINTAGE ANYWHERE, so under the rule this project has now applied five times, THE SEARCH CAN BE ABANDONED AT THE RANGE PAGE: an undated cuvee page cannot be matched to a bottling even if a list appeared on it tomorrow. This was the largest single-producer cluster left in the French 2024+ pool — six wines — and it was chosen for exactly that sibling economics. It cost five requests to close all six, which is the case for continuing to prefer clusters even when the hit rate is low. No platform is referenced anywhere: no m. subdomain, no vincod.com code, no alliance-alsace.com GS1 URL, no u-label. FR (EU) pages; the site is French-only.

declarations.evidence: THE FIRST FRENCH DECLARATION ATTACHED IN THIS PROJECT. Château du Trignon is a Famille Quiot property (bought 2006), which is why Systembolaget's producer field reads Famille Quiot; the estate hub m.famillequiot.com lists it alongside Vieux Lazaret, Duclaux, Houchart and Verlaque. The platform is VINCOD, reached from the producer's own linking; the wine page's <select id="millesime"> names a short code per vintage back to 2020, so the 2024 was reached from the producer's own control and never by guessing. IDENTITY: the e-label heading reads 'Château du Trignon, Viognier 2024' — producer, cuvée and vintage stated by the disclosure itself, and the cuvée name is unique in the estate's eleven-wine range (the other whites are Roussanne and Marsanne). PACK: 'Contenance: Bouteille (75 cl)' against Systembolaget's 750 ml. ALCOHOL: the e-label states 'Alc. 13 % vol.', which is Systembolaget's 13,0 exactly. Note that the WINE page's Spécifications block says 13.5 % vol — that is the analysis figure, not the labelled strength; on Vincod the /n/ page carries the labelled alcohol and it is the one that matches. PER-WINE, NOT BOILERPLATE: the three Quiot lists read this run differ from one another — this one has Acide tartrique and 'Sulfites', the Vieux Lazaret rouge has Acide tartrique and 'Peut être mise en bouteille sous atmosphère protectrice', the Houchart rosé has 'Dioxyde de soufre' and no tartaric acid. declarations.name: Domaine Houchart Côtes de Provence Rosé
declarations.evidence: A SISTER-CUVÉE COLLISION INSIDE ONE ESTATE, AND THE FIRST TIME THIS PROJECT HAS FAILED ON THE CUVÉE RULE WITH THE DECLARATION IN HAND. Famille Quiot publishes two 2024 Vincod e-labels for a Domaine Houchart Côtes de Provence rosé: 'Houchart Tradition Rosé 2024' (362WAF) and 'Houchart, Les Cigales, Rosé, 2024' (U682WF). They share grapes (Cinsault, Grenache noir, Syrah, Tibouren), the identical presentation, terroir, vinification and tasting texts, 13 % vol, 75 cl and the appellation. THE LABELS THEMSELVES CARRY NO CUVÉE NAME: both read only 'Domaine Houchart / Côtes de Provence / Mis en bouteille au domaine', so Systembolaget's 'Domaine Houchart Côtes de Provence Rosé' is exactly what either label yields and the name does not discriminate. The declarations are not identical either — the ingredient lists match word for word ('Raisins, Dioxyde de soufre, MétaBisulfite de potassium, Acide métatartrique, Mis en bouteille sous atmosphère protectrice') but the energy differs, 319 kJ / 76 kcal on Tradition against 318 kJ / 76 kcal on Les Cigales, so these are two disclosures for two items and picking one is a guess. THE VISUAL EVIDENCE POINTS BOTH WAYS. Systembolaget's product photo is the 2022 bottling: a Provençal flute with a black 'FAMILLE QUIOT 1748' capsule and a cream oval label. Les Cigales is bottled in exactly that flute (its 2025 packshot is filed as 'Packshot Houchart Provencale(Flute2026)') while Tradition is in a straight-shouldered bottle in both its 2022 and its current packshot — which favours Les Cigales; but Les Cigales' Vincod millesime selector starts at 2023, so it did not exist when Systembolaget's 2022 photo was taken, which favours Tradition. Les Cigales' ambience photograph is also filed as 'sweden lake with Houchart', a hint that the flute bottling is the Swedish item and not evidence of anything. Under the rule — if the cuvée is uncertain, do not attach — this is a rejection. It is recorded as 'rejected' rather than 'not_found' because a complete declaration was found and read; what failed is the match. Resolvable cheaply by anyone holding the bottle: the two differ by the two gold cicadas on the Les Cigales label. The Cru Sainte-Victoire rosé was ruled out on appellation.

` plus three Angular bundles (polyfills, scripts, main) and a Google reCAPTCHA site key. declarations.evidence: A FAMOUS ESTATE WHOSE ENTIRE WEBSITE IS ONE PDF. Château de Saint Cosme, Gigondas, Louis Barruol, est. 1570 — and www.saintcosme.com is a 3,9 kB page containing a logo and four links: 'Livret 2026' and 'Page 2026' in French, 'Booklet 2026' and 'Page 2026' in English. No navigation, no shop, no per-wine page, no robots restrictions beyond a crawl-delay of 10 s. The booklet decides the producer, so it was fetched once (19,6 MB, 48 pages) and read in full. IT CONTAINS NO INGREDIENT LIST AND NO NUTRITION TABLE. A text search of all 48 pages returns ZERO for ingrédient, nutrition, kcal, kJ, énergie (as a nutrition heading), étiquette, QR and vincod. What it does contain per wine is grapes, élevage, terroir, a tasting line and a painting credit — the French fiche-technique near-miss, in book form. IT ALSO REPRODUCES THE LABELS, and the extracted label text is the reason to record this precisely: it reads 'APPELLATION GIGONDAS PROTÉGÉE / 2024 / RED RHONE WINE - PRODUCT OF FRANCE - CONTAINS SULFITES / RÉCOLTÉ, ELEVÉ, MIS EN BOUTEILLE AU CHATEAU PAR LOUIS BARRUOL'. An allergen statement on a reproduced label is not a declaration — no substances listed, no energy value — and the estate's repeated 'Mise en bouteille sans collage ni filtration' is the negative-list trap already recorded for Etienne Simonis. No QR platform is referenced anywhere in the booklet or on the page. FOR THIS WINE SPECIFICALLY: the booklet DOES carry our exact bottling — 'SAINT COSME / Côtes du Rhône rouge 2025', Syrah, partially destemmed, concrete fermentation and ageing, villafranchian terraces. Producer, cuvée and vintage all match and there is still no ingredient list on the page. This is the fourth French producer to have our exact bottle on its own surface and declare nothing on it.

Inside that description the producer publishes a QR-code image whose anchor is https://v9.lu/v/dhoPn, and the code is per wine: the shop's Viognier Gourmand carries a different one, https://v9.lu/v/c07yu. That is a QR destination on a dedicated short host and is the regulated disclosure channel. BOTH URLS ANSWER HTTP 200 WITH FIFTEEN BYTES: the literal string 'Smartphone only'. v9.lu serves no robots.txt (404), so nothing is disallowed and no exception was needed — the page is simply device-gated, and reading it would mean sending a user agent we are not. This project identifies itself with its own User-Agent (src/http.py) and does not misrepresent its client, so the fetch stops here, exactly as it stops at a geoblock. Recorded as not_found rather than rejected: a declaration was located but never read, so nothing was matched and nothing was rejected. THIS IS THE BEST REVISIT CANDIDATE IN THE FRENCH POOL — the URL is held, the vintage and market are confirmed from the producer's own SKU, and only the device gate is in the way. Everything else on the producer's surface is the usual near-miss: www.domainegassier.com's page is headed 'Domaine Gassier Viognier 2024' and links a per-vintage technical sheet (EN-Domaine-Gassier-Viognier-24-IGP-Gard-1.pdf, read in full) giving terroir, varietal, vinification, tasting notes, a Jeb Dunnuck score, ageing potential and food pairings, with no ingredient list, no nutrition table and no energy value; the shop's own 'Fiche technique complete' link is staler still, pointing at the 2023 IGP Pays d'Oc PDF. The shop's only sulphite statement is 'Teneur en SO2 totale' followed by a JPEG — an analysis figure rendered as an image, which is neither an ingredient list nor machine-readable. UPDATE 2026-08-08, under the device-gate exception decided the same day: fetched with a mobile-shaped User-Agent (Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone...) ... vindeklaration/0.1 (...)+https://github.com/matalve/vindeklaration), which still self-identifies the project. https://v9.lu/v/dhoPn returned the full VINISCAN disclosure page: a nutrition table (328 kJ/79 kcal per 100 mL) and an ingredient list (grape, ascorbic acid, acidity regulator, metatartaric acid/yeast mannoproteins, sulphites), quoted verbatim in raw_ingredients/raw_nutrition/raw_allergens. ONE LIMIT, STATED PLAINLY: unlike Winestro/Winitas pages, this VINISCAN page does not restate the wine name, vintage or alcohol strength anywhere on it — it is a bare template keyed only by the URL slug. The vintage/wine match therefore rests entirely on the sourcing chain already recorded above (the URL was extracted from the live famillegassier.fr product page titled literally 'Embruns de Viognier 2024", SKU MGVIBL24EU06CF, and the sibling Viognier Gourmand carries a demonstrably different v9.lu code), not on anything the disclosure page itself asserts. That sourcing chain is treated as sufficient here on the same footing as a QR code printed on the physical bottle would be — the producer's own page is what ties this exact code to this exact vintage — but it is weaker evidence than a self-identifying page and is flagged as such rather than presented as equal.

declarations.evidence: A NEW FRENCH E-LABEL PLATFORM, AND THE GATE IN FRONT OF IT TURNED OUT TO BE A REFERER CHECK. Domaine André Brunel's own site, andre-brunel.fr, keeps one page per cuvée per vintage. Ours is /sommelongue.2024-599200-92.php, headed 'Côtes-du-Rhône rouge : cuvée Sommelongue 2024', offering 'Bouteille 75 cl.' and stating 'Degré d'alcool 14.5 %'. Systembolaget's 7181001 is the Côtes du Rhône Cuvée Sommelongue, Domaine André Brunel, 2024, 750 ml, 14,5 % — producer, cuvée, vintage, pack and strength all match exactly, and the wine is the estate's own bottling, not a négoce label. (Systembolaget lists Cinsault as a fourth grape where the estate's page gives Grenache 80 %, Mourvèdre 10 %, Syrah 10 %; grape lists are not one of the four matching rules and everything that is one agrees, so this is noted, not treated as a discrepancy.) At the foot of that page, inside a blockquote, the estate writes '>> Cliquez ici pour retrouver la liste des ingrédients et informations nutritionnelles de cette cuvée <<', linking https://iviti.fr/v/?q=VgoSw-aqU2Zbgh6BEwOgfdLbZc. THE TOKEN IS PER WINE: the sibling page for Côtes du Rhône Est-Ouest 2024 carries q=xifLp-aqU2Zbgh6BEwOgfdLbZc — a different prefix on the same trailing producer segment — so this code belongs to this cuvée and not to the range. iviti.fr IS ABSOMOD'S VINISCAN, THE SAME PLATFORM AS v9.lu: the page's own title is 'VINISCAN API', its author meta is 'ABSOMOD', its footer reads '© 2026 VINISCAN by ABSOMOD GROUP', and every stylesheet and script it loads is served from v9.lu/commonfiles/. The AFNIC whois for iviti.fr names the registrar as ABSOMOD Group. HOW IT WAS READ, STATED IN FULL. iviti.fr serves no robots.txt (404), so nothing is disallowed. A plain request to the e-label URL returns HTTP 200 and sixteen bytes: 'Accès refusé...'. Retried once with the mobile-shaped User-Agent from the 2026-08-08 device-gate decision — the same sixteen bytes, so this is NOT a device gate. Two controlled requests then isolated the actual check: the project's ordinary User-Agent plus a browser-shaped Accept header and no Referer still returns 'Accès refusé...', while the project's ordinary User-Agent plus 'Referer: https://andre-brunel.fr/sommelongue.2024-599200-92.php' returns the full disclosure. It is hotlink protection, and the Referer sent is simply true: that page is where this URL was found and where the request came from. No device framing, no user-agent misrepresentation and no technological measure was worked around — the fetch that succeeded identifies itself as vindeklaration/0.1 exactly as every other fetch in this project does. Note separately that iviti.fr's own root answers HTTP 403 to everything; that is an absolute refusal, it was hit once and not retried, and nothing on the host was touched beyond the one URL the producer published. WHAT THE PAGE DOES AND DOES NOT SAY. It carries the nutrition table and the ingredient list and nothing else — no wine name, no vintage, no bottle size, no alcohol. Exactly the Gassier/VINISCAN limitation: the identity rests entirely on the sourcing chain above (a per-cuvée, per-vintage page on the producer's own domain, with a per-wine token), not on anything the disclosure page asserts about itself. That is weaker than a self-identifying Winestro or Vincod page and is flagged as such rather than presented as equal.

Domaine du Salvard (Famille Delaille, Cheverny) sells from its own Shopify storefront at delaille.com — none of domainedusalvard.com, domaine-du-salvard.fr or salvard.fr resolves, and the Shopify host answers on a wildcard so the m-subdomain Vincod probe is meaningless. Its robots.txt is the standard Shopify file, products allowed, carrying the documented agent-addressing preamble that is page content and not an instruction to us. The product page /products/cheverny-blanc-domaine-du-salvard carries no declaration itself, but its footer and sidebar both link a site page, /pages/declaration-nutritionnelle, headed 'Déclaration nutritionnelle', and that page holds the full mandated set quoted above: an ingredient list ('Raisins/Grapes'), an allergen line, metatartaric acid, protective-atmosphere bottling, and a nutrition table per 100 ml with 328 kJ / 79 kcal. WHY IT IS REJECTED. The page names no wine, no cuvée, no appellation, no colour, no bottle size and no vintage — the strings 'Cheverny', 'Blanc', 'Rouge', 'Rosé' and 'Millésime' appear on it zero times. It is one declaration for the estate's entire range, which the matching rules exclude in terms: 'a generic one covering a producer's whole range is not this bottle's EU declaration'. That is not a technicality here, because the estate makes at least a white, a red, a rosé and a crémant, and a single ingredient list cannot be a per-wine disclosure for all of them. THE VINTAGE FAILS INDEPENDENTLY. Systembolaget's 7110601 is the Cheverny Blanc 2024; the producer's own product JSON gives 'Millésime : 2025', SKU 30000, 750 mL, 'Alcool : 12,5%', 85 % Sauvignon Blanc and 15 % Chardonnay. The strength and the pack agree with Systembolaget's 12,5 % and 750 ml and the grapes agree with its Sauvignon blanc/Chardonnay, but the shop has rolled a year past our bottle, and the declaration page is not dated either way — so there is nothing on this estate's surface that ties this text to the 2024 bottling. Recorded as rejected rather than not_found because a complete declaration was found and read; it is the match that fails, twice. IT IS STILL THE MOST PROMISING SHAPE SEEN IN THE LOIRE: a producer that has understood the obligation and answered it in the cheapest possible way, one page for everything. If a future run needs a rule for this shape, the question is whether a range-wide undated list may ever be attached to a specific bottling — and today's answer is no.

declarations.name: Peche Coquin Rosé
declarations.evidence: THE BEST FRENCH NEAR-MISS IN THE FILE: THE ESTATE HOSTS ITS OWN E-LABELS AND PUBLISHES THEM ONLY FOR ITS ALCOHOL-FREE RANGE. Domaine La Provenquiere (famille Robert-Boularand, Capestang, Herault) runs a WordPress site at provenquiere.com (robots.txt is Yoast's, 'User-agent: *' with an EMPTY 'Disallow:', everything allowed) and a PrestaShop at caveau.provenquiere.com. THE WORDPRESS SITE HAS A '/label-qr/' SECTION THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT THIS AGENT LOOKS FOR — its hub reads 'Retrouvez sur cette page tous les QR Code du domaine : - QR vin pour les valeurs Nutritionnel de nos vins ou vins sans alcool', and the page sitemap names FOUR of them, all French, all mirrored in /en/ and /de/: qr-peche-coquin-zero, spritz-sans-alcool, sauvignon-sans-alcool, blanc-de-blancs-chardonnay-00. One was read and it is a complete, well-formed declaration: 'Ingredients** Extrait de levure (eau, Levure), Jus de Raisin, Acidifiants (Acide Lactique, Acide Citrique), Conservateurs ( E220**, E202, E242), Aromes Naturels, Gaz Carbonique (CO2)' with a nutrition table per 100 ml at 96 kJ / 23 kcal. EVERY ONE OF THE FOUR IS A 0,0 % PRODUCT. THERE IS NO QR PAGE FOR ANY WINE THE ESTATE ACTUALLY MAKES AS WINE, AND NONE FOR OURS. declarations.name: Anima Mia Sauvignon Blanc
declarations.evidence: A '/qrcode' PAGE THAT IS NOT AN E-LABEL, AND A SCHEDA TECNICA THAT IS THE ITALIAN NEAR-MISS. Pico Maccario (Mombaruzzo, Asti, Piemonte) is at www.picomaccario.it — WordPress/Divi, WPML, robots.txt 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/' with an admin-ajax Allow, everything else permitted, so nothing was set aside. Its wp-sitemap has no product post type and thirteen pages in all, ONE OF WHICH IS LITERALLY NAMED /qrcode01 — the most promising-looking URL of the batch and a false positive: it is a QR landing page for the sales catalogue, whose only two outbound links are issuu.com/grart01/docs/picomaccario2025_ita and ..._eng. A page called 'qrcode' on an Italian producer is as likely to be a catalogue or a tasting-menu redirect as a 2021/2117 disclosure. THE WHOLE RANGE IS ON ONE PAGE, /vini, AS SEVENTEEN 'SCHEDA / INFO' LINKS TO PER-CUVEE PDFs, AND THE SCHEDA IS NOT A DECLARATION. Lavignone-Barbera.pdf was fetched and its text extracted in full: denominazione, vitigno, coltivazione, esposizione, altitudine, terreno, vendemmia, vinificazione, affinamento, tasting note, ageing potential, service temperature, 'Formato: 0,75 l - 1,5 l - 3 l' and 'Chiusura: Tappo tecnico'. NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE, NO ENERGY VALUE, NOT EVEN A SULPHITE LINE, AND NO VINTAGE — it is a cuvee sheet, not a bottling sheet, so it fails the vintage rule as well as the substance rule. One PDF settles the template for the estate and the other sixteen were not fetched. THE UPLOAD PATH LIED IN THE OTHER DIRECTION, AND THAT IS THE FINDING WORTH CARRYING: all seventeen PDFs sit under /wp-content/uploads/2019/06/, which the file's own rule says to read as predating the obligation — but a HEAD on Lavignone-Barbera.pdf returns 'last-modified: Thu, 03 Jul 2025', so WordPress had REPLACED THE FILE IN PLACE and kept the 2019 path. A WordPress upload path is the date of first upload, not of the current bytes; check Last-Modified before closing a producer on the path. 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'solfiti', 'etichetta', 'elabel', 'e-label' and 'kcal' are zero on /vini in both raw HTML and stripped text. THE SHOP IS THE ONE THING NOT READ AND IT WAS REFUSED BY ROBOTS: the site's /shop page is a single outbound link to pico-maccario-shop.myshopify.com, whose robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' — an ordinary retail storefront, not a disclosure page, so the e-label exception does not reach it and it was honoured in full. Vincod probe negative (m.picomaccario.it does not resolve; picomaccario.com resolves to a different address, 80.88.85.16, and does not complete a TLS connection at all). THIS WINE: ANIMA MIA IS ABSENT FROM THE PRODUCER'S OWN RANGE. /vini lists seventeen cuvees and the only sauvignon among them is 'VITA SAUVIGNON'; the string 'anima mia' does not occur anywhere on the page. Whether the Swedish item is Vita under an export name or a separate bottling cannot be settled from the producer's surface, and a similar name is not a match.

declarations.name: Vermentino Aragosta Santa Maria La Palma
declarations.evidence: A CO-OP WITH A FIRST-PARTY SHOP THAT CARRIES OUR EXACT VINTAGE AND STILL DECLARES NOTHING BUT AN ALLERGEN LINE. Cantina Santa Maria La Palma (Alghero, Sardinia; Societa cooperativa agricola per Azioni, P.IVA IT00061210902) runs two first-party hosts and both allow crawling in full: www.santamarialapalma.it (WordPress/WPBakery, robots.txt is the Yoast block with 'User-agent: *' and an EMPTY 'Disallow:') and shop.santamarialapalma.it (nopCommerce, robots.txt disallows only /login, /register and /boards/, plus blanket blocks on AhrefsBot and SemrushBot which we are not). THE MARKETING SITE'S PER-CUVEE PAGES END IN EXACTLY THE ITALIAN NEAR-MISS: colour, nose, palate, food pairing, service temperature, then 'Allergeni: contiene solfiti' and 'Origine: Prodotto in Italia', and nothing else. An allergen statement and a country of origin are two of the label's mandatory particulars and they are NOT the ingredient list or the nutrition declaration — no substances, no energy value, no kJ, no kcal. The pages state no vintage either. 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'elabel', 'e-label', 'kcal' and 'kJ' are zero on every page read, raw and stripped, and the only PDF or QR link anywhere on the range pages is none at all. THE SHOP IS THE INTERESTING PART AND IT IS WHY THESE ARE CLEAN NOT_FOUNDS RATHER THAN VINTAGE MISSES: nopCommerce gives every wine a product-attribute selector literally labelled 'Annata', and Aragosta's current option is 2025 alongside a 'Formato' of 75cl — SO THE PRODUCER'S OWN CHANNEL IS ON OUR EXACT BOTTLING, and it repeats the same 'Allergeni: Contiene Solfiti / Origine: Prodotto in Italia' block with no ingredient list. A shop that models the vintage as a first-class attribute and still publishes no declaration is the strongest available evidence that the absence is editorial, not structural. The shop's sitemap holds 119 URLs and not one of them matches 'etichett', 'qr', 'nutri', 'ingred' or 'label'. Vincod probe negative: m.santamarialapalma.it does not resolve, with an NXDOMAIN control. THIS WINE: OUR EXACT BOTTLING IS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SHOP. shop.santamarialapalma.it/aragosta offers Formato '75cl' and Annata '2025', which matches Systembolaget's 750 ml 2025 exactly, and states 'Alcool: 12,5% - 13% vol.' — a range whose upper bound is Systembolaget's 13,0. Producer, cuvee, vintage, pack and market all match and there is simply no declaration on the page to attach.

declarations.name: Albia Rosé
declarations.evidence: THE BEST-STRUCTURED ITALIAN PRODUCER OF THE BATCH AND IT PUBLISHES NO INGREDIENT LIST ANYWHERE. Barone Ricasoli S.p.A. Societa Agricola (Brolio, Gaiole in Chianti; P.IVA 00393620489) runs www.ricasoli.com (WordPress/WPBakery, robots.txt 'User-agent: *' disallowing exactly one ebook path, everything else allowed) and the shop eshop.ricasoli.com (ASP.NET WebForms; robots.txt is a soft 404 returning the site's HTML, so there are no directives at all). ITS PRODUCT SITEMAP IS A GENUINE PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE — 808 URLs, one page per wine per vintage per language, back to 2006, with a <select> on each page naming every other vintage of that wine. That is the Vincod-style vintage control this project prizes, on a producer's own WordPress, and OUR 2024 IS THERE: /prodotto/albia-rose-2024/ heads 'ALBIA 2024 / Rose Toscana Igt' and gives 'Dati analitici — Alcol: 13% vol., Acidita totale: 5,67 g/L, pH: 3,11, Estratto secco: 16,26 g/L', which matches Systembolaget's 13,0 exactly. AND THAT IS ALL IT GIVES. 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'etichett', 'qr', 'kcal', 'kJ' and 'solfiti' are ZERO in the raw HTML of the page — the analytical block is the Italian equivalent of the French Specifications block and is not a declaration. A FALSE POSITIVE WORTH NAMING: the sitemap contains hundreds of URLs of the form /de/etikette/{wine}-{vintage}/, and 'Etikette' is German for label. It is not an e-label — WPML translates the 'prodotto' post-type slug as 'etikette' in German, and /de/etikette/albia-rose-2024/ was fetched and is the identical marketing page in German ('Analysedaten — Alkohol: 13% vol.'), with zero matches for 'Zutat', 'Nährwert', 'kcal' and 'Sulfit'. On an Italian site, /etichetta/ or /etikette/ in a URL is as likely to be a translated post-type slug as a disclosure. THE OTHER TWO ROUTES ARE ALSO EMPTY. (1) The 'SCHEDA TECNICA' button on each product page points at /wp-content/uploads/2018/01/{Wine}-{Vintage}.pdf — per-vintage file names on a 2018 path, which is the Pico Maccario shape again — but Albia-Rosato-2024.pdf answers HTTP 404. The producer's own scheda link is broken. (2) The 'ACQUISTA' button points at eshop.ricasoli.com/it/shop/vini/vini-bianchi-e-rosati/albia-rose-2024/, WHICH ALSO 404s: the shop has rolled forward to the 2025 while the marketing site keeps the archive. The live 2025 product page was read and declares nothing either — 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'kcal', 'energia', 'solfiti', 'allergen' and 'valori' are all zero in its stripped text — SO THIS IS A CLEAN NOT_FOUND AND NOT A VINTAGE REJECTION: there is no declaration for the 2025 to be rejected against. Vincod probe negative (m.ricasoli.com does not resolve, NXDOMAIN control). THIS WINE: OUR EXACT BOTTLING HAS ITS OWN PAGE: /prodotto/albia-rose-2024/, 'ALBIA 2024 / Rose Toscana Igt', Sangiovese and Merlot, 'Alcol: 13% vol.' against Systembolaget's 13,0. Producer, cuvee, vintage, market and strength all match and there is no declaration on it.

declarations.name: Ricasoli Albia Rosé
declarations.evidence: THE BEST-STRUCTURED ITALIAN PRODUCER OF THE BATCH AND IT PUBLISHES NO INGREDIENT LIST ANYWHERE. Barone Ricasoli S.p.A. Societa Agricola (Brolio, Gaiole in Chianti; P.IVA 00393620489) runs www.ricasoli.com (WordPress/WPBakery, robots.txt 'User-agent: *' disallowing exactly one ebook path, everything else allowed) and the shop eshop.ricasoli.com (ASP.NET WebForms; robots.txt is a soft 404 returning the site's HTML, so there are no directives at all). ITS PRODUCT SITEMAP IS A GENUINE PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE — 808 URLs, one page per wine per vintage per language, back to 2006, with a <select> on each page naming every other vintage of that wine. That is the Vincod-style vintage control this project prizes, on a producer's own WordPress, and OUR 2024 IS THERE: /prodotto/albia-rose-2024/ heads 'ALBIA 2024 / Rose Toscana Igt' and gives 'Dati analitici — Alcol: 13% vol., Acidita totale: 5,67 g/L, pH: 3,11, Estratto secco: 16,26 g/L', which matches Systembolaget's 13,0 exactly. AND THAT IS ALL IT GIVES. 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'etichett', 'qr', 'kcal', 'kJ' and 'solfiti' are ZERO in the raw HTML of the page — the analytical block is the Italian equivalent of the French Specifications block and is not a declaration. A FALSE POSITIVE WORTH NAMING: the sitemap contains hundreds of URLs of the form /de/etikette/{wine}-{vintage}/, and 'Etikette' is German for label. It is not an e-label — WPML translates the 'prodotto' post-type slug as 'etikette' in German, and /de/etikette/albia-rose-2024/ was fetched and is the identical marketing page in German ('Analysedaten — Alkohol: 13% vol.'), with zero matches for 'Zutat', 'Nährwert', 'kcal' and 'Sulfit'. On an Italian site, /etichetta/ or /etikette/ in a URL is as likely to be a translated post-type slug as a disclosure. THE OTHER TWO ROUTES ARE ALSO EMPTY. (1) The 'SCHEDA TECNICA' button on each product page points at /wp-content/uploads/2018/01/{Wine}-{Vintage}.pdf — per-vintage file names on a 2018 path, which is the Pico Maccario shape again — but Albia-Rosato-2024.pdf answers HTTP 404. The producer's own scheda link is broken. (2) The 'ACQUISTA' button points at eshop.ricasoli.com/it/shop/vini/vini-bianchi-e-rosati/albia-rose-2024/, WHICH ALSO 404s: the shop has rolled forward to the 2025 while the marketing site keeps the archive. declarations.evidence: AN UNDATED ONE-PAGE RANGE, WHICH IS THE CHEAPEST POSSIBLE CLOSE. Zorzettig (Azienda Agricola Zorzettig, Spessa di Cividale, Colli Orientali del Friuli) is at www.zorzettigvini.it — WordPress/Salient, robots.txt is the Yoast block with 'User-agent: *' and an EMPTY 'Disallow:', everything allowed. declarations.name: Vinosìa Falanghina Beneventano
declarations.evidence: THE PRODUCER'S SITE IS DOWN WITH A WORDPRESS DATABASE ERROR, WHICH IS AN OUTAGE AND NOT A REFUSAL. Vinosia Aziende Agricole srl (Luciano Ercolino, Paternopoli, Irpinia, Campania) is at vinosia.it (81.88.52.169). Every content URL — the root, /sitemap_index.xml and /wp-sitemap.xml over both http and https — answers HTTP 500 with WordPress's own styled 'Database Error' page, 2 482 bytes, on three requests. A 500 is a server error, not a 401/403/429, not a login wall and not a bot challenge, so nothing was worked around and nothing was retried in a loop. The apex vinosia.com and www.vinosia.com resolve to the SAME address and answer a bare Apache 404 for every path including the root, and https://vinosia.com does not complete a TLS connection at all — so the .com is a parked alias of the broken .it, not an alternative site. No other candidate domain resolves (vinosiawines.com, www.vinosiawines.com, vinosia.eu are all NXDOMAIN). ROBOTS: vinosia.it/robots.txt is served as a static file and still answers 200 while the application is down. It is 92 bytes generated by 'Simple Robots.txt 0.1' and its ONLY groups are 'User-agent: MSNBot' and 'User-agent: bingbot', each with 'Crawl-delay: 5' and no Disallow — there is no 'User-agent: *' group, so under RFC 9309 our token matches no group and nothing is disallowed. That is the bpdr.com reading of 2026-08-08 applied to an Italian host, and it is recorded here rather than left implicit; in this case it changed nothing, because there was nothing readable to fetch. THESE ARE REVISIT CANDIDATES. All three wines are 2025 — the current release — so if the site comes back it is likelier than most to be about our bottling, and the producer has not been shown to publish or to fail to publish anything. THIS WINE: Falanghina Beneventano IGT, 12,5 % vol., 750 ml.

declarations.name: Domìni Veneti Custoza
declarations.evidence: THE FIRST READABLE ITALIAN INGREDIENT LIST OF THIS BATCH — AND IT IS FOR A DIFFERENT BRAND'S WINES, NOT OURS. Cantina Valpolicella Negrar (Societa cooperativa, Via Ca' Salgari 2/A, Negrar di Valpolicella, P.IVA 00220900237) sells to Sweden under its Domini Veneti brand and runs two first-party WordPress hosts, both allowing crawling: dominiveneti.it (Yoast block, 'User-agent: *' with an EMPTY 'Disallow:') and www.cantinanegrar.com (robots.txt disallows /wp-admin/ only, with an admin-ajax Allow). THE BRAND SITE DECLARES NOTHING. dominiveneti.it's wine-sitemap holds 37 cuvee pages and both of ours are on it — /wine/custoza-doc/ and /wine/valpolicella-doc-classico/ — and each is a 420 kB Elementor page on which 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'etichett', 'qr', 'kcal', 'kJ', 'solfiti', 'allergen', 'energia' and 'annata' are ZERO in the raw HTML as well as in the stripped text. No vintage is stated on either page, and there is no shop and no PDF. THE GROUP SITE HOSTS ITS OWN E-LABELS AND THERE ARE EXACTLY THREE. cantinanegrar.com's page-sitemap is 42 URLs, six of which match a declaration-ish word, and three of those six are real disclosures: /it/valori-nutrizionali-gransignoria-{bardolino-doc-classico, valpolicella-ripasso-doc-classico-superiore, amarone-della-valpolicella-docg-classico}. One was read in full and it is a proper, well-formed Italian ingredient list under the heading 'Elenco degli ingredienti': 'Uva, Mosto concentrato; Conservanti e antiossidanti: Metabisolfito di potassio, Dimetildicarbonato (DMDC); Agenti stabilizzanti: Gomma arabica, Mannoproteina di lievito, Poliaspartato di potassio. Prodotto imbottigliato in atmosfera protettiva.' ALL THREE ARE 'GRANSIGNORIA', WHICH IS NEITHER OF OUR WINES AND IS NOT EVEN THE DOMINI VENETI BRAND — it is a separate line, and the co-op has published an e-label for it and for nothing else. Adoption, again, is per product line rather than per producer. TWO THINGS ABOUT THE PAGE WORTH CARRYING FORWARD. (1) The heading 'Dichiarazione nutrizionale' is followed by an — /wp-content/uploads/valori-nutrizionali-bardolino-gransignoria.png, 590x182 — so THE NUTRITION TABLE IS A PICTURE AND ONLY THE INGREDIENT LIST IS TEXT. A self-hosted Italian e-label can be half-readable. (2) The page states NO VINTAGE, no lot, no bottle size and no alcohol, so it identifies itself no better than f-label or apys do; a find on this platform would rest entirely on the producer's own linking. THE OTHER THREE MATCHES ARE A DIFFERENT OBLIGATION: /it/etichettatura-ambientale-... and /it/etichettatura-montigoli are PACKAGING labelling pages under the Italian environmental-labelling decree (which material each component is and which bin it goes in). 'Etichettatura ambientale' is a near-miss to recognise on sight — it is not the 2021/2117 disclosure. Vincod probe negative: m.dominiveneti.it and m.cantinanegrar.com do not resolve, with NXDOMAIN controls. THIS WINE: The cuvee has its own page, dominiveneti.it/wine/custoza-doc/, which is undated and declares nothing. There is no valori-nutrizionali page for any Custoza on the group site.

THE BRAND SITE DECLARES NOTHING. dominiveneti.it's wine-sitemap holds 37 cuvee pages and both of ours are on it — /wine/custoza-doc/ and /wine/valpolicella-doc-classico/ — and each is a 420 kB Elementor page on which 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'etichett', 'qr', 'kcal', 'kJ', 'solfiti', 'allergen', 'energia' and 'annata' are ZERO in the raw HTML as well as in the stripped text. No vintage is stated on either page, and there is no shop and no PDF. THE GROUP SITE HOSTS ITS OWN E-LABELS AND THERE ARE EXACTLY THREE. cantinanegrar.com's page-sitemap is 42 URLs, six of which match a declaration-ish word, and three of those six are real disclosures: /it/valori-nutrizionali-gransignoria-{bardolino-doc-classico, valpolicella-ripasso-doc-classico-superiore, amarone-della-valpolicella-docg-classico}. One was read in full and it is a proper, well-formed Italian ingredient list under the heading 'Elenco degli ingredienti': 'Uva, Mosto concentrato; Conservanti e antiossidanti: Metabisolfito di potassio, Dimetildicarbonato (DMDC); Agenti stabilizzanti: Gomma arabica, Mannoproteina di lievito, Poliaspartato di potassio. Prodotto imbottigliato in atmosfera protettiva.' ALL THREE ARE 'GRANSIGNORIA', WHICH IS NEITHER OF OUR WINES AND IS NOT EVEN THE DOMINI VENETI BRAND — it is a separate line, and the co-op has published an e-label for it and for nothing else. Adoption, again, is per product line rather than per producer. TWO THINGS ABOUT THE PAGE WORTH CARRYING FORWARD. (1) The heading 'Dichiarazione nutrizionale' is followed by an — /wp-content/uploads/valori-nutrizionali-bardolino-gransignoria.png, 590x182 — so THE NUTRITION TABLE IS A PICTURE AND ONLY THE INGREDIENT LIST IS TEXT. A self-hosted Italian e-label can be half-readable. (2) The page states NO VINTAGE, no lot, no bottle size and no alcohol, so it identifies itself no better than f-label or apys do; a find on this platform would rest entirely on the producer's own linking. THE OTHER THREE MATCHES ARE A DIFFERENT OBLIGATION: /it/etichettatura-ambientale-... and /it/etichettatura-montigoli are PACKAGING labelling pages under the Italian environmental-labelling decree (which material each component is and which bin it goes in). 'Etichettatura ambientale' is a near-miss to recognise on sight — it is not the 2021/2117 disclosure. Vincod probe negative: m.dominiveneti.it and m.cantinanegrar.com do not resolve, with NXDOMAIN controls. THIS WINE: The cuvee has its own page, dominiveneti.it/wine/valpolicella-doc-classico/, which is undated and declares nothing. The group's only Valpolicella e-labels are the GranSignoria Ripasso Classico Superiore and the GranSignoria Amarone — a different line and, in both cases, a different wine.

declarations.evidence: THE FIRST ITALIAN DECLARATION READ IN THIS PROJECT, AND IT IS INLINE ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SHOP. Gruppo Italiano Vini S.p.A. (GIV, Calmasino di Bardolino) is Italy's largest wine group and owns the Bolla brand. Two first-party surfaces: www.gruppoitalianovini.it, a Next.js brand site (robots.txt allows everything but faceted-search query strings), and www.vinicum.com, GIV'S OWN E-COMMERCE (robots.txt disallows only /account/* and /*?o=, and names its sitemap). The brand site is the hub — bolla.it and bolla.com both 301 into /it/brand/bolla — and its per-wine pages carry a tasting note, a grape line and no declaration at all; its 'Acquista' button points at vinicum.com. VINICUM'S PRODUCT PAGE CARRIES THE COMPLETE MANDATED SET, SERVER-RENDERED, AND A RAW GREP OF THE STRIPPED TEXT MISSES IT ENTIRELY. The declaration lives in the Apollo GraphQL state embedded in the HTML, as a DescrizioneAggiuntivaProdottoType with chiave 'allergeni' and titolo 'Informazioni Nutrizionali', whose 'testo' is a single newline-delimited string headed INGREDIENTI / ALLERGENI / VALORI NUTRIZIONALI (PER 100 ML). It is a 380 kB page on which 'ingredien', 'nutrizion', 'kcal', 'kJ', 'solfiti', 'allergen' and 'energia' are ZERO in the stripped text and one or two each in the RAW HTML — the exact inverse of the usual grep trap, and the reason to grep raw as well as stripped. THE LISTS ARE WRITTEN PER WINE, not from a house template: the Bardolino's stabiliser is gum arabic and the Soave's antioxidant is L-ascorbic acid, and their energy values differ (293 kJ against 291 kJ). THE PAGE IDENTIFIES ITSELF WELL. Rendered 'dato-prodotto-main' fields give Vitigno, Colore, Gradazione, ANNATA and FORMATO, and the URL carries GIV's own article number and pack code (68134-06 = article 68134, six-bottle case of the 750 ml). That is Winestro-grade provenance on an Italian first-party shop. AND IT IS WHY BOTH WINES ARE REJECTIONS RATHER THAN FINDS: vinicum keeps ONE PRODUCT PER CUVEE, EDITED FORWARD, and both had rolled to the Annata 2025 while Systembolaget's shelf holds the 2024. The Rhonea and Paul Mas failure mode, in Italy, on the first Italian producer that publishes anything. THIS WINE: PRODUCER, CUVEE, PACK AND STRENGTH ALL MATCH AND THE VINTAGE DOES NOT. GIV's brand site files article 68134 under Bolla's 'La Fondazione' line, which is exactly Systembolaget's product name 'Bolla Bardolino Classico La Fondazione'; the vinicum page's rendered fields read Colore Rosso, Gradazione 12.5% Vol., Formato 'Bottiglia 750 ml' and ANNATA 2025, against Systembolaget's 750 ml and 12,0 %. The strength gap is 0,5 pp, exactly at the EU labelling tolerance and therefore not itself disqualifying, but the vintage is a year out and that is a rejection, not an approximation. The declaration is quoted in full here so no refetch is needed if a 2024 page ever appears.
