declarations.name: Terlan Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Cantina Terlano / Kellerei Terlan (Terlano, Alto Adige, a 143-grower co-op) runs one first-party site on two hostnames, www.cantina-terlano.com and www.kellerei-terlan.com, serving the same content in de/it/en. There is no webshop: /kontakt/onlinepartner/ links out to third-party retailers. IT IS THE SECOND ITALIAN PRODUCER WITH A REAL PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE, after Ricasoli, and it still declares nothing. The Tradition range page links one page per wine (/weine/pinot-grigio-20/, the trailing number an internal id, not a vintage), and each wine page carries a 'Weitere Jahrgänge' list of 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019, each vintage a ?wine-id={n} query on the same slug. The default page is the current release. For the Pinot Grigio that is the 2025 (Jahrgang: 2025, Alkoholgehalt: 13,5 % vol) and NOT our 2024. The page carries Wein (origin, DOC, grape, vintage, yield, slope, altitude), Ausbau, Technische Daten (alcohol, residual sugar, total acidity), serving and food notes, a vintage report, and a 'Recyclinginformationen' block giving the capsule, cork and bottle materials with their Italian recycling codes — that is the ETICHETTATURA AMBIENTALE obligation, not 2021/2117, and it is the clearest case yet of a producer meeting one label obligation on the web and not the other. Zero matches for Zutat, Nährwert, Inhaltsstoff, kcal, kJ, Energie, ingredien, solfiti or Sulfit in raw HTML and in stripped text. The only 'etichetta' hit is the filename of the label photograph.
declarations.note: THE 2024 PAGE ITSELF WAS NOT FETCHED AND THIS IS A ROBOTS LIMIT, NOT AN OVERSIGHT. cantina-terlano.com/robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with Disallow: /assets/, /logs/, /media/, /redaxo/, /usage/ and — the one that binds here — 'Disallow: /*?*', which disallows every query string. The vintage archive is reached only as /weine/pinot-grigio-20/?wine-id=192 (2024). This is an ordinary marketing site with no e-label on it, so the 2026-07-30 disclosure exception does not reach it and the directive was honoured in full. The template is identical across vintages and the readable 2025 page of the same wine carries no declaration, so the conclusion is safe on the evidence available, but the 2024 page was not read. The sitemap named in robots.txt answers HTTP 500 with a Laravel 'Ooops, something went wrong!' page. Two web searches for a Terlan e-label or QR destination returned only generic EU-regulation explainers and retailers.

declarations.name: Terlan Pinot Noir
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT BOTTLING IS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN PAGE AND IT DECLARES NOTHING. /weine/pinot-noir-25/ is the Tradition Blauburgunder and its default vintage is the current release, which is our 2025: 'Jahrgang: 2025', 'Sorte: 100% Blauburgunder', 'Alkoholgehalt: 13,5 % vol' against Systembolaget's 13,5 % — an exact match on producer, cuvée, vintage and strength, reached without a query string and so without touching the disallowed archive. The page gives origin, DOC, grape, vintage, yield, slope, altitude, vinification, residual sugar 0,9 g/l, total acidity 5,4 g/l, glass and serving temperature, food pairing, a vintage report and a Recyclinginformationen block (the Italian environmental-labelling decree, not 2021/2117). NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE, NO ENERGY VALUE, NOT EVEN A SULPHITE LINE — zero matches for Zutat, Nährwert, kcal, kJ, Energie, ingredien, solfiti and Sulfit in raw HTML as well as stripped text. This is the Ricasoli finding in Alto Adige: a producer with genuine per-vintage editorial control over its own wine pages, publishing the analysis and the recycling codes and not the ingredients.
declarations.note: The only per-wine link that leaves the site is an 'Etikett' JPEG of the front label and a 'PDF Download' at /weinbrief/?w-id={wine}&l-id={lang} — a Weinbrief datasheet, and a query string, so disallowed by 'Disallow: /*?*' and not fetched. Nothing on the site describes it as an ingredient or nutrition disclosure, so the disclosure exception does not apply to it either.

declarations.name: Köfererhof Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Köfererhof (Kerschbaumer, Neustift/Varna, Valle Isarco — 6 ha, seven white varieties) has A THREE-PAGE SQUARESPACE BROCHURE SITE AND NO PER-WINE PAGE AT ALL. www.koefererhof.it serves one 116 kB document for /, /willkommen, /benvenuto and /welcome — the German, Italian and English versions of a single page about the estate, its 976 founding, its terraces at 650–700 m and its cellar. The complete set of internal links is /, /deutsch, /italiano, /english, /willkommen, /benvenuto, /welcome and /search: there is no range page, no product page, no shop and no vintage stated anywhere on the site. The words Kerner, Grigio, Ruländer, Sylvaner and Riesling appear zero times. Nothing to vintage-match even if a declaration existed, which is the Italian undated-page failure in its most extreme form — not an undated cuvée page but no cuvée page. A web search for a Köfererhof e-label or QR destination returned only foreign retailers (wine.com, Tannico, Pur Südtirol, Meraner Weinhaus).
declarations.note: robots.txt is Squarespace's stock file: a long list of AI-crawler tokens AND 'User-agent: *' in ONE group, so unlike bpdr.com the group binds everyone and the 2026-08-08 RFC 9309 reading is not needed. Nothing it disallows is relevant (/config, /search, /account, /api/, /static/ and a set of query-string forms). The sitemap it names returns a VALID BUT EMPTY <urlset/>, 211 bytes with zero <loc> elements — a Squarespace site with no indexable collections, which is itself the finding. NEW FALSE POSITIVE: the homepage matches 'e-label' four times in raw HTML and zero in text, every hit a Squarespace CSS class — 'event-date-label' and 'Mobile-overlay-folder-item--toggle-label'. Add it to the responsiveLabel/Beaver Builder list.

declarations.name: Köfererhof  Kerner
declarations.evidence: Same estate and same close as product 7045701: www.koefererhof.it is a three-page Squarespace brochure with no per-wine page, no shop, no vintage and an empty sitemap, so there is no producer surface on which the Kerner 2024 exists, let alone a declaration. The wine itself is real and widely sold (Alto Adige Valle Isarco DOC, 100 % Kerner, 13,5 % vol) but every page a search returns for it is a foreign retailer — wine.com, Empire Wine, Tannico, Pur Südtirol, trentinoaltoadigewine.it — and a retailer's transcription is explicitly not a source for this project.
declarations.note: Systembolaget's alcohol for both wines is 13,5 %, which agrees with the retailers' figure for the Kerner 2024 — noted only because it confirms the identity of the bottle, not because anything was found to attach to it.

declarations.name: Hans Rottensteiner Alto Adige Sauvignon
declarations.evidence: Weingut Hans Rottensteiner Srl, Via Sarentino 1a, Bolzano — third generation, founded 1956. The estate's own site is rottensteiner.wine (WordPress, it/de/en), reached after www.rottensteiner-wein.com turned out not to resolve at all. Six range pages (Kitz, Classic, Cru, Select, Trigon, Passito) link one page per cuvée, and the page for our wine states 'Annata 2025' and '14,5 % vol' against Systembolaget's 2024 and 14,0 % — ONE PRODUCT PAGE PER CUVÉE, EDITED FORWARD, the Rhonéa/Paul Mas/GIV failure mode again. Our 2024 is not on the site as a bottling; it appears only in the Premi block, where six critics' scores are attributed to 'Vintage 2024'. The page's only outbound per-wine links are SHOP ONLINE and PRODUCT SHEET. NOTHING RESEMBLING A DECLARATION IS ON THE PAGE: zero raw-HTML and zero stripped-text matches for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, allergen, energia, kcal, kJ, Zutat and Nährwert.
declarations.fetch_result: shop product page HTTP 403
declarations.note: THE SHOP IS A 403 AND WAS NOT WORKED AROUND. The marketing page's SHOP ONLINE link is https://www.shop.rottensteiner.wine/en/sauvignon-sudtirol-doc-39, a Magento store on a separate host; a single plain request returned HTTP 403 with a 5,8 kB body. That is a technological measure and absolute under the project's rules — no retry, no header games, recorded and left. Its robots.txt would have allowed the product URL (the Disallow list is Magento's stock directories plus about ninety '/*{brand}$' anchored brand-landing slugs, Crawl-Delay 10, sitemap named), so this is a refusal by the server and not by the directives. Worth knowing for later Italian work: those ninety brand slugs show the store sells far beyond Rottensteiner — antinori, zenato, ferrari, livio_felluga, tenuta_dell_ornellaia, angelo_negro and antonio_facchin among them, the last two also in this project's remaining Italian pool — but the host answers 403, so it is not a source for any of them. rottensteiner.wine itself sets Crawl-delay: 10 and every request to it in this run was spaced by at least nine seconds.

declarations.name: Hans Rottensteiner Alto Adige Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Same estate, same shape as product 7171301. The Pinot Grigio page reads 'Annata 2025' and 'Gradazione 13,4 % vol' against Systembolaget's 2024 and 14,0 %; our vintage survives only in the Premi block (Kerin O'Keefe 93, Jancis Robinson 16/20, James Suckling 90, Falstaff 90, Decanter and Wein Plus, all 'Annata 2024'). No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value and no sulphite line anywhere in raw HTML or stripped text. AND THE SCHEDA TECNICA WAS FETCHED AND SETTLES THE TEMPLATE FOR THE WHOLE ESTATE: https://rottensteiner.wine/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/2025_Pinot_Grigio_it.pdf is a 192 kB one-pager giving annata 2025, grape 100 %, training system, soil, yield 6 000 l/ha, vessel, production 25 000 bottles, drinking window, serving temperature, total acidity 5,8 g/l, residual sugar 2,0 g/l and 13,4 % vol, then STORIA / PROVENIENZA / VINIFICAZIONE / DESCRIZIONE prose. Zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion and allergen. It is the Italian scheda tecnica in its purest form and it is not a declaration. One PDF settles the estate; the Sauvignon's equivalent (2025_Sauvignon_eng.pdf) was not fetched.
declarations.note: THE WORDPRESS UPLOAD-PATH TRAP, CONFIRMED A SECOND TIME. Both schede sit under /wp-content/uploads/2021/06/ and the Pinot Grigio's answers Last-Modified: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 16:27:35 GMT — a 2026 file at a 2021 path, exactly as Pico Maccario's 2019/06 schede did. The filename, not the path, carries the vintage here ('2025_Pinot_Grigio_it.pdf'), which makes the range page a cheap vintage census: the estate documents only its current release and no 2024 PDF is linked from anywhere on the site.

declarations.name: Pranzegg Tonsur white field blend
declarations.evidence: Pranzegg — Martin Gojer, Kampennerweg 8, Bolzano, biodynamic, IT BIO 013 — runs a fourteen-page Wix site (www.pranzegg.com) with one page per cuvée and no shop; orders are by email against a price list. /tonsur is our exact cuvée and it links three PDFs whose anchor texts are 'Weinbrief 2021', 'scheda tecnica 2021' and 'data sheet 2021' — the German, Italian and English versions of one datasheet, AND THE ONLY VINTAGE THE ESTATE DOCUMENTS IS 2021, three years behind our 2024. THE DATASHEET WAS FETCHED AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION: 'TONSUR L2021 / White field blend: MüTh 55%, PB, Sy, Ch', then vineyard, soil, viticulture, vine age 34 years, plot 0,4 ha, density, yield, a vintage report, vinification, maturation ('without fining or filtration'), 4000 bottles, Alcohol 11,5 %, Residual Sugar <1 g/l and TOTAL SO2 35 MG/L. An SO₂ analysis figure is the French Revelette near-miss in German — it reads like an additive declaration and is not one: no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value. One PDF settles the template for the estate and the other eight cuvées were not fetched. Alcohol 11,5 % does match Systembolaget's 11,5 %, but for the 2021 bottling.
declarations.note: A '/download' PAGE THAT IS NOT A DOWNLOAD CENTER. The pages-sitemap lists /download, which is the Carl Loewen signature and the reason this producer was probed carefully; it turns out to be an alias of the wines index page (same title, same pageId prefix, no file links at all). The Loewen recogniser is 'Download Center'/'Presse' PLUS 'eLabels', and the second half is what is missing here. robots.txt is Wix's stock file: 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: *?lightbox=', a PetalBot block, and Crawl-delay 10 for dotbot and AhrefsBot only. NEW FALSE POSITIVES on Wix: 'kJ' matches 64 times in the raw HTML of one page and zero in the text — every hit is either base64 PNG data ('…ErkJggg==') or the bundler symbol 'webpackJsonp'. Add it to the checkJQuery / __VIEWSTATE list.

declarations.name: MiauMiau PetNat Rosé Pranzegg
declarations.evidence: The cuvée matches — /miau-miau is 'Miau!Miau!, vino rosato frizzante', a pét-nat of indigenous varieties bottled with must added in October and refermented in bottle, which is our MiauMiau PetNat Rosé. The page again links only 'Weinbrief 2021' / 'scheda tecnica 2021' / 'data sheet 2021', so the estate's documented vintage is 2021 against our 2024, and the Tonsur datasheet already established that the template carries an SO₂ figure and no ingredient list. The page's own text is vineyard, soil, biodynamic viticulture and vinification, plus a 'DIFFERENZIARE I RIFIUTI' table giving bottle GL70 and crown cap C/FE91. NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE, NO ENERGY VALUE, NO SULPHITE LINE.
declarations.note: SECOND ITALIAN PRODUCER IN THIS BATCH TO PUBLISH THE PACKAGING OBLIGATION AND NOT THE INGREDIENT ONE. Every Pranzegg wine page carries the etichettatura ambientale table (material code and bin per component) exactly as Cantina Terlan's 'Recyclinginformationen' does. Two estates, two regions, same choice: the Italian environmental-labelling decree is met on the web and Regulation 2021/2117 is not. Curiosity worth recognising on a natural-wine site: Pranzegg writes its grapes as 'La..ein' and 'Ver…sch' — Lagrein and Vernatsch with letters removed, because the wines are table wines that may not name a DOC variety. A grape-name string search will miss them.

declarations.name: Pranzegg Rosso per tutti
declarations.evidence: AND THE CUVÉE ITSELF IS UNCERTAIN HERE, WHICH WOULD BLOCK A FIND EVEN IF ONE EXISTED. Pranzegg's site lists nine cuvées — Tonsur, Elysion, Caroline, GT, Miau!Miau!, Demian, Vino Rosso Leggero, Ca'l and Laurenc — and NONE of them is called 'Rosso per tutti'. The only candidate is /vinorossoleggero, 'VINO ROSSO LEGGERO, leichter Rotwein aus heimischen Sorten Ver…sch, La..ein', an easy-drinking Vernatsch/Lagrein red that fits the Swedish bottle's profile but not its name. The estate may label it 'rosso per tutti' on the bottle or for export, and it may not; nothing on the producer's surface says so. Under the matching rules that is an unresolved cuvée and the wine is closed. It is moot in any case: the page links only the 2021 Weinbrief / scheda tecnica / data sheet, three vintages behind ours, and the estate's datasheet template carries an SO₂ figure and no ingredient list.
declarations.note: The whole Pranzegg site is server-rendered and readable despite being Wix — the per-wine text and the PDF hrefs are in the HTML — but the pages are 670–690 kB each for about 1,5 kB of text. Budget for the size.

declarations.name: Riesling Trentino
declarations.evidence: Cantina La-Vis (Lavis, Trentino, a co-op of the Colline Avisiane) runs two first-party surfaces: the marketing site la-vis.com — www.cantinalavis.it 301s to it — and the group's own WooCommerce shop lavinotecalaviscembra.it, shared with its sister co-op Cembra Cantina di Montagna. BOTH WERE READ AND NEITHER DECLARES ANYTHING. The marketing page for our exact cuvée is the Italian undated cuvée page in textbook form: line (I Classici), grape, zone, exposure, altitude, soil, training, planting density, vinification, food pairing, 'Grado alcolico 12% vol.' — which matches Systembolaget's 12,0 exactly — serving temperature, and a Riconoscimenti list whose awards are dated by vintage (2023, 2022, 2021, 2018) while the page itself states none. IT DOES LINK A PER-VINTAGE SCHEDA TECNICA AND IT IS OUR VINTAGE: 'Classici_Riesling_Lavis_vintage24.pdf'. THE PDF WAS FETCHED AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION — the same fields as the page (vitigno, esposizione, terreno, allevamento, densità, vinificazione, abbinamenti, 12 % vol., serving temperature) and zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion and allergen. The shop's product page adds weight, ageing potential and a 1,25 kg shipping weight and links the PREVIOUS vintage's sheet, 'Classici_Riesling_Lavis_vintage23.pdf'; it states no annata at all and matches none of the declaration markers either.
declarations.note: THE GIV PREDICTOR WAS TESTED HERE AND FAILED. The closing advice of the first Italian batch was to prefer groups that run their own e-commerce, because that is where both Italian declarations were found. La-Vis is exactly that shape — a co-op group with a 50-product WooCommerce store of its own — and the store carries no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no allergen line and no vintage field. Running your own shop is not sufficient. TWO CHEAP THINGS THIS PRODUCER TEACHES: (1) A SCHEDA TECNICA FILE NAME CAN CARRY THE VINTAGE WHERE THE PAGE DOES NOT — '…_vintage24.pdf' — so on an undated Italian cuvée page, read the PDF href before giving up on vintage-matching; and (2) the two surfaces disagree, the marketing site being one vintage ahead of the shop, so a producer's own vintage marker depends on which of its sites you read. NEW FALSE POSITIVE: 'e-label' matches 35 times in the raw HTML of every la-vis.com page and zero in the text — all of them the cookie banner's 'cm-cookie-label' class. Both robots.txt files are permissive (Yoast's 'User-agent: * / Disallow:'); la-vis.com's sitemap_index names a wine-sitemap of 43 per-cuvée URLs in it/en, which is a one-request range census.

declarations.name: Cantina Lavis Sauvignon
declarations.evidence: Same producer, same template, and here the documented vintage is behind ours as well as the page being undated. The I Classici Sauvignon page gives grape Sauvignon Blanc, zone Giovo, exposure, soil, training, density, vinification, pairing and 'Grado alcolico 12,5% vol.' — matching Systembolaget's 12,5 — and no vintage; its awards are attributed to Vintage 2024 and its scheda tecnica is 'Classici_Sauvignon_Lavis_vintage24.pdf', one vintage behind our 2025. The Riesling's sheet was fetched and settles the template for the estate — analysis and prose, no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value — so this one was not fetched. Nothing on la-vis.com or on the group shop lavinotecalaviscembra.it carries a declaration for any wine.

declarations.evidence: THE FIRST ITALIAN DECLARATION THIS PROJECT HAS ATTACHED TO A WINE, AND IT IS INLINE ON THE PRODUCER'S ORDINARY MARKETING PAGE. Az. Agr. Cà dei Frati, Via Frati 22, Lugana di Sirmione (BS), P.IVA 00631300985 — the Dal Cero family estate, Lombardia, which is Systembolaget's producer and region. https://cadeifrati.it/vini/pratto/ is the page for the cuvée Pratto and it states, in server-rendered HTML in a block of its own immediately above the ingredient heading: 'Annata: 2024', 'Bottiglia: 750 ml', 'Grado alcolico: 13 % vol', 'PRODOTTO IN ITALIA – CONTIENE SOLFITI'. ALL FIVE MATCHING TESTS PASS EXACTLY: producer Cà dei Frati; cuvée Pratto (the estate's only wine of that name — its range is I Frati, Brolettino, Pratto, Rosa dei Frati, Ronchedone, Tre Filer, Cuvée dei Frati and the Privilegio di Famiglia bottlings, none of them confusable); VINTAGE 2024 against Systembolaget's 2024; pack 750 ml against 750 ml; alcohol 13 % vol against 13,0 %, a difference of zero. The declaration itself is a proper 'Ingredienti' list — grapes, concentrated must, stabilisers (citric acid, gum arabic, CMC), preservatives and antioxidants (sulphites, L-ascorbic acid), bottled under protective atmosphere — followed by a 'Dichiarazione nutrizionale per 100 ml' table with energy in kJ and kcal and the full six rows. The page's 'Scarica la scheda tecnica' link is /wp-content/uploads/2026/07/pratto2024_ST.pdf, whose file name independently confirms the vintage the page is describing. THE LIST IS A HOUSE TEMPLATE BUT THE DECLARATIONS ARE PER WINE: Pratto and Rosa dei Frati carry a word-for-word identical ingredient line and DIFFERENT energy values (337 kJ / 81 kcal against 317 kJ / 76 kcal), which proves two disclosures rather than one boilerplate.
declarations.note: THE DECLARATION IS NOT WHERE THE QR CODE POINTS, AND THAT IS THE LESSON. cadeifrati.it's sitemap index contains a custom post type sitemap, qr-code-promo-sitemap.xml, listing 96 URLs in a two-level shape — /qr-code-promo/{wine}-landing/ (a bare language chooser) and /qr-code-promo/{wine}-landing/{wine}/ in it/en/de. It is the most e-label-shaped URL tree seen in Italy so far and it is NOT an e-label: the leaf page is a tasting note, the estate's history and a Wine Experience booking pitch, with zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia. The actual declaration sits on the ordinary /vini/{wine}/ marketing page, which no QR tree points at. An Italian producer can run QR landing pages for marketing and meet 2021/2117 somewhere else entirely — check /vini/ before concluding from a /qr-code-promo/ page. robots.txt is Yoast's permissive 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' and no exception was needed anywhere on this host. Same 'e-label' raw-HTML false positives as elsewhere in this batch: 18 hits, all 'slideLabel' and 'whitelabel' in JavaScript, zero in text.

declarations.name: Marchesi di Barolo Moscato d´Asti Zagara
declarations.evidence: Cantine dei Marchesi di Barolo S.p.A., Via Alba 12, Barolo (CN), P.IVA IT00169530045 — the estate itself, and OUR EXACT BOTTLING IS ON ITS OWN SHOP WITH NOTHING DECLARED ON IT. shop.marchesibarolo.com is the house's own e-commerce (robots.txt 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /', sitemap named, 2 503 URLs) and it keeps ONE PRODUCT PER VINTAGE, not one per cuvée: the sitemap holds moscato-d-asti-zagara-docg-2024 AND …-2025 as separate products, which is the vintage control this project usually only gets from Vincod. The 2024 page states 'Annata 2024', 'Denominazione DOCG', 'Vitigni Moscato 100%', 'Alcol 5%', 'Formato 0.75l' — matching Systembolaget's 2024, 5,0 % and 750 ml exactly — and under a heading 'Info' the single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. THAT IS THE ITALIAN NEAR-MISS AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION: two of the label's mandatory particulars, no substances, no nutrition table, no energy value. Zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia and allergen in raw HTML and in text. The market and language were selected as /it/eur/it — Italy, euro, Italian — which is the EU consumer view; the shop also offers en and de and fifteen other shipping countries including the United States, and none of those was used.
declarations.note: TWO HOST QUIRKS. 'www.marchesibarolo.com' fails TLS with a hostname mismatch (the certificate does not cover the www form) and 'www.marchesidibarolo.com' fails with an unresolvable issuer — the live site is the apex 'marchesibarolo.com'. That apex serves a SOFT 404 for /robots.txt: HTTP 200 carrying a black '404 – Pagina non trovata' page, so there are no directives on the marketing host at all (the shop subdomain has a real and permissive one). The marketing site is a pre-rendered Nuxt static export — 1 MB of HTML per page for under 2 kB of text, but fully server-readable, so unlike Les Quatre Tours' Nuxt SPA it is not a rendering dead end. ITS PER-CUVÉE PAGES ARE UNDATED (Zagara's states grape, 5 % Vol, Formato 0,75 l and no vintage) AND THE SHOP'S ARE NOT — on an Italian producer with both surfaces, go to the shop for the vintage. The marketing page's 'Scheda tecnica' is /pdf/it/{slug}.pdf; zagara.pdf was fetched and is zona di produzione, vinificazione and organoleptic prose with zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion, allergen and even 'annata' — an undated scheda tecnica, so it settles the template for the estate and no second PDF was fetched.

declarations.name: Marchesi di Barolo Dolcetto d´Alba Madonna del Dono
declarations.evidence: Same shop, same template, same absence. The per-vintage product page reads 'Dolcetto d'Alba MADONNA DEL DONO Doc 2024', 'Annata 2024', 'Vitigni Dolcetto 100%', 'Alcol 13%', 'Formato 0.75l', and under 'Info' the same single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value. declarations.note: The shop's sitemap is a cheap and unusually complete census: 2 503 URLs, one per product per market per language, the market segment being /{country}/{currency}/{lang}/ and the vintage being part of the product slug. One fetch tells you every vintage of every wine the house sells and in which markets — worth remembering for any producer on the same platform (support is at marchesidibarolo@wineplatform.it, so the vendor appears to be 'wineplatform.it').

declarations.name: Donna di Valiano Chardonnay
declarations.evidence: Tenute Piccini S.p.A., Località Piazzole, Castellina in Chianti (SI), P.IVA 00368360525 — an eleven-brand Tuscan group (Piccini, Valiano, Torre Mora, Tenuta Moraia, Regio Cantina, Villa al Cortile, Geografico, Porta Rossa, Donna Gloria, Bastioni della Rocca) running its own first-party e-commerce at shop.piccini1882.it, which is exactly the shape the last Italian batch recommended starting from. OUR EXACT BOTTLING HAS ITS OWN PRODUCT PAGE AND DECLARES NOTHING. The page reads 'Donna di Valiano Toscana Chardonnay IGT 2024 - Valiano', 'Annata 2024', 'Vitigni Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc', 'Alcol 13%', 'Formato 0.75l', and under a heading 'Info' the single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value; zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia and allergen in raw HTML and in text. Vintage and pack match Systembolaget exactly; the alcohol is 13 % against Systembolaget's 12,5 %, half a point, which is moot with nothing to attach. The corporate site www.piccini1882.it (WooCommerce, /catalogo/ and /prodotto/{slug}/) carries no declaration either and its product pages link out to this shop.
declarations.note: A PLATFORM IS NOW IDENTIFIED AND IT IS THE SAME ONE MARCHESI DI BAROLO USES. Both shops answer at {shop}.{producer}.it with the path /{country}/{currency}/{lang}/prodotti/{slug-with-vintage}, both name their sitemap from a permissive 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /' robots.txt, and both print the identical field set — Annata, Denominazione, Vitigni, Alcol, Formato, Temperatura di servizio, then 'Info: Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia'. Marchesi's customer-care address is marchesidibarolo@wineplatform.it, so the vendor is wineplatform.it. IT IS EXCELLENT FOR IDENTITY AND EMPTY OF DECLARATION: one product per vintage, the vintage in the slug and in the page, the pack and the strength stated — and an allergen line where the ingredient list should be. Two producers, four wines, the same near-miss. Recognise it and expect nothing. Its sitemap is a complete census (8 221 URLs here, 263 Italian-market products across all eleven brands) and is the cheapest possible vintage check. TRAP: the <title> is stale where the H1 is current — this page's title says 'IGT 2023' and the Collezione Oro's says '2022', while both H1s say 2024. Read the H1 and the Annata field, never the title.

declarations.name: Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Organic
declarations.evidence: THE CUVÉE DOES NOT EXIST ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SURFACE, WHICH WOULD BLOCK A FIND EVEN IF THERE WERE ONE. Systembolaget sells 'Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Organic' 2024, 750 ml, 13,0 %, flagged organic, Sangiovese, in the fast assortment. Tenute Piccini's own shop lists 263 Italian-market products and its Collezione Oro range is Chianti Governo 2023, Chianti Riserva 2022, Chianti Superiore 2022/2023/2024, Rosso Toscana, Rosato, Orvieto Classico and a Gran Cuvée — AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS ORGANIC. The group does sell organic wines and labels them plainly, with 'bio' in the slug (Histrio Anfora, Scalunera, Calandrino, Primasso, Il Pacchia, Genesi, Casarossa, Valiano Chianti Classico bio), so the absence of a bio Collezione Oro is informative rather than an artefact of naming. The nearest sibling, Collezione Oro Chianti Superiore DOCG 2024, was read to be sure: same producer, same range, same vintage, 13 % vol and 0,75 l matching Systembolaget — and zero occurrences of bio, biologico or organic anywhere in its HTML. That is a different bottling, so it cannot stand in for ours. This is the export-only brand rule at the level of a single SKU: an organic bottling made for a foreign shelf and absent from the producer's own catalogue. Its page would have declared nothing in any case — every product on this shop carries only 'Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia'.
declarations.note: Recorded not_found rather than rejected because nothing was found to reject — no declaration was read for any candidate bottling. The identity failure is worth flagging separately for a later run: if Piccini ever publishes, this wine will still need the organic Chianti to appear on the producer's surface before anything can be attached to it.

declarations.fetch_result: 200, but the site is a maintenance placeholder; TLS certificate mismatch on the host (see note)
declarations.note: HOST QUIRK: www.paoloscavino.com and paoloscavino.com both resolve to 146.59.214.79 (plskx-r5.sistnet.it, a Sistnet shared host) and serve a certificate whose CN and SANs are sistnet.it, *.sistnet.it and *.sistnet.cloud only — the producer's own hostname is not in it, so every verified HTTPS request fails with a hostname mismatch, and plain HTTP 301s to HTTPS. The maintenance page was read once with certificate verification disabled; that is a broken server configuration, not a refusal (no 401, 403, 429 or challenge), but it does weaken authentication, so NOTHING WOULD HAVE BEEN ATTACHED FROM THIS HOST WITHOUT NOTING IT. Moot here: the page carries no wine content at all. Revisit candidate — all three Scavino wines are 2024/2025 and the site is explicitly being rebuilt.

declarations.name: Marco Porello Roero Arneis

declarations.name: La Pruina Primitivo Sole Range
declarations.raw_ingredients: Uve, conservanti (E220, E224), agenti stabilizzanti (E414, mannoproteine), L’imbottigliamento può avvenire in atmosfera protettiva
declarations.evidence: La Pruina Vini (Salento, Puglia). The estate's WooCommerce product page https://www.lapruinavini.com/product/primitivo-puglia/ is headed 'La Pruina Primitivo Puglia IGP', states 'ANNATA 2024', 'Vitigno: Primitivo', 'Titolo alcolometrico: 12,5%', 'E/100 ML: 326 kJ / 78 kcal', 'PRODOTTO IN ITALIA', 'CONTIENE SOLFITI', is tagged 'Sole Range', and ends with an anchor reading 'VALORI NUTRIZIONALI E INGREDIENTI | SMALTIMENTO — CLICCA QUI' pointing at https://app.ioagri.it:443/Qr/DL?id=74046361. FIVE INDEPENDENT THINGS TIE THAT E-LABEL TO THIS BOTTLE. (1) The e-label's own CompanyName is 'La Pruina Vini' and its ProductName is literally 'La Pruina Primitivo Puglia IGP Sole Range' — Systembolaget's product name is 'La Pruina Primitivo Sole Range'. (2) Its AlcoholPercentage is '12,50' against Systembolaget's 12,5 % — exact. (3) Its energy, 326 kJ / 78 kcal per 100 ml, is the same figure the producer's own product page prints, and it differs from the sibling Sole Range Negroamaro's 322/77 and from the Manduria DOP's 331/79, so this is a per-wine disclosure and not a house template. (4) The producer's 'Sole Range' tag archive contains exactly two products, this one and the Negroamaro, matching the two Sole Range wines Systembolaget lists. (5) The grape is Primitivo on both sides. declarations.name: La Polda Spumante Rosé
declarations.evidence: Az. Agr. VIGNA '800 di Elampini Gianfranco, Via Moron 46, Negrar di Valpolicella, P.IVA 03267950230 — a Squarespace marketing site (vigna800.com) plus a separate Squarespace shop (vigna800shop.com). Our wine has its own page, /lapolda, headed '"LA POLDA" ROSÉ Spumante Vino Spumante Rosato BRUT', 'Vitigni: 100% Corvina BIO', 'Analisi: alcol 12% vol; acidità totale 6,9 g/l; residuo zuccherino 8,2 g/l; pressione 5,5 atm' — cuvée, grape, organic status and strength all match Systembolaget, AND THE PAGE STATES NO VINTAGE. Its 'SCHEDA TECNICA' PDF, /s/schede_Spumante.pdf, was downloaded and read in full: bilingual IT/EN, soil, grape, yield, harvest, vinification, organoleptics, food pairing, then a data block giving Alcol 12% vol, Acidità totale 6,9 g/l, Residuo zuccherino 8,2 g/l, Pressione 5,5 atm — no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value, no sulphite line and no vintage. The Italian scheda tecnica near-miss in its purest form. Neither the marketing page nor the shop page carries any of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia or dichiarazione in raw HTML or in stripped text.
declarations.note: THE MOST EXPLICIT INTENTION TO PUBLISH SEEN IN ITALY, AND THE LINK IS DEAD. Every page of vigna800.com carries, in its site-wide footer, an anchor reading literally 'Ingredienti/smaltimento' — the two obligations named together — pointing at /s/schedaAMARONE_2023_ITA_EN.pdf. THAT URL RETURNS HTTP 404 (Squarespace's Italian 'Non è stato possibile trovare la pagina che stai cercando'), confirmed by HEAD and by GET, and it is the same dead link on the English pages ('/la-polda-eng' footer). So one PDF, named for the Amarone 2023, was meant to serve as the whole estate's ingredients-and-disposal document and is no longer there. No replacement URL is linked anywhere on either host, and guessing one is exactly what this agent must not do. Recorded as not found, with the broken link named so a later run can see it was looked for. Both hosts are Squarespace and both robots.txt files put 'User-agent: *' in the SAME group as the named AI crawlers, so the group binds us and no RFC 9309 reading arises (the Köfererhof shape, not the bpdr.com shape); only /config, /search, /account, /api, /static and a list of query-string forms are disallowed, none of which was fetched. Confirmed false positives on both hosts: 'e-label' matches Squarespace's 'event-date-label' and Iubenda's 'whitelabel', and 'kJ' matches base64 image data.

Conservanti: <strong class="ingredient-list__allergen">solfiti</strong></p></div>. FIVE THINGS MATCH SYSTEMBOLAGET EXACTLY. (1) Producer: the shop is the estate's own, on its own subdomain, and the product's Brand attribute is 'Demarie Azienda Agricola'. (2) Cuvee: the Appellation attribute is 'Langhe DOC Dolcetto' and Systembolaget's name is 'Demarie Langhe Dolcetto'; Demarie makes exactly one Dolcetto in its fifteen-wine range. declarations.robots_reasoning: livon.it serves a 67-byte robots.txt — 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/ / Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php' — so every content path is allowed. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: THE VINTAGE IS ONLY IN THE DOWNLOAD'S Content-Disposition FILENAME. The /download/{id}/ URLs are opaque WordPress Download Monitor ids and the anchor text is just 'scheda pdf'; the served file announces itself as LIVON__Classica_1_pinot_grigio_2025.pdf. That is the current edition of the sheet and its PDF text names no year, so it cannot be read as a vintage statement — but it is a cheap probe worth repeating: one GET, read the Content-Disposition, and you learn what year the estate is currently documenting without opening a 1,4 MB file. Note also that the estate keeps a Livon Classica Sauvignon Blanc and a Villa Chiopris Sauvignon, two different estates' wines on one site, so the Press Area's flat list of wine names is ambiguous and must be read by the section heading above it.

declarations.name: Livon Sauvignon Blanc
declarations.evidence: Same estate and same site as product 5726801. Our wine's page is /scheda-livon-classica-sauvignon-blanc/ = 'LINEA Classica / Sauvignon Blanc D.O.C. Collio', vigneto Dolegna del Collio Ruttars, marne ed arenarie, Guyot, macerazione a freddo in pressa, vinificazione, caratteristiche organolettiche, abbinamenti — and again NO VINTAGE, no alcohol, no pack, and zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, allergen, ingredient-list, etichett, elabel and ioagri in raw HTML and in stripped text. Its Press Area scheda pdf was not downloaded a second time: the sibling Pinot Grigio sheet, read in full, settles the template for the estate (one PDF settles the template, per this file's standing rule) and the two web pages are the same layout field for field.
declarations.robots_reasoning: livon.it allows every content path; no exception used.
declarations.note: Livon is the undated-cuvee-page failure in its purest form: a four-estate group with sixty per-wine pages, a full press area, per-wine technical sheets in two languages — and not one year, alcohol figure or substance anywhere on the surface.

declarations.name: Prunotto Fiulot Barbera d'Asti
declarations.evidence: Prunotto, Alba (CN), Piemonte — a Marchesi Antinori estate, running Antinori's own WordPress theme (wp-content/themes/antinori) on its own domain. THE PAGE IS AT OUR EXACT VINTAGE: /it/vino/fiulot-barbera-d-asti-docg/ defaults to the 2024, its bottle shot is uploads/2018/06/Fiulot_2024.png, its Clima paragraph opens 'L'annata 2024 e iniziata con un inverno mite' and its Vendemmia line reads '17 settembre ... 2 ottobre 2024'. The page carries Clima, Vendemmia, Vinificazione, Dati Storici, Note Degustative and a 'Scarica scheda tecnica' button, and NOTHING ELSE — zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, allergen, ingredient-list, elabel, e-label, etichett, u-label, ioagri, scantrust and qr in the raw HTML as well as in the stripped text. No alcohol figure and no pack size either. So this is a producer page that satisfies the vintage rule exactly and still declares nothing.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.prunotto.it: 'Sitemap: .../sitemap.xml / User-agent: * / Disallow: /de/' — the German tree only; every Italian URL fetched is allowed, query strings included. www.26generazioni.com carries two 'User-agent: *' groups, the first disallowing four wp-content and wp-admin paths and the second (a Yoast block) an empty 'Disallow:'; the sitemaps fetched are outside the disallowed paths under either reading. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: TWO DEAD ENDS WORTH RECORDING. (1) The 'Scarica scheda tecnica' button is /it/vino/{wine}/?gen_pdf=1, and it answers HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf and a body of ZERO BYTES — over curl and over httpx alike. A producer's own PDF generator can be broken while returning 200; check the length before spending a parse. (2) THE ANTINORI GROUP SHOP DOES NOT COVER PRUNOTTO'S SWEDISH WINES. www.26generazioni.com is the group's WooCommerce and is where Marchesi Antinori's Scantrust e-label links were found on 2026-07-28; its product sitemap holds 166 products and exactly two are Prunotto (Barbaresco 2023, Barolo 2022). Neither Fiulot nor Moscato d'Asti exists there in any vintage, and no product of any brand in that sitemap is a Barbera or an Asti wine. The Antinori e-label route is therefore closed for Prunotto, and closing it cost three fetches.

declarations.name: Prunotto Moscato d'Asti
declarations.evidence: Same estate and site as product 5736201. The Moscato page has rolled forward to the 2025, but PRUNOTTO KEEPS A PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE and our year is on it: the page carries a year strip 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 whose links are /it/vino/moscato-d-asti-docg/?wineyear={year}. The ?wineyear=2024 page was fetched and read; like every other Prunotto page it gives Clima, Vendemmia, Vinificazione, Dati Storici and Note Degustative and stops. Zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, allergen, ingredient-list, elabel, etichett and ioagri in raw HTML and in stripped text, for the 2024 page and the current 2025 page alike. The vinification paragraph does state '...fino a ottenere una gradazione di 5% di alcol', which matches Systembolaget's 5,0 % exactly, but a strength in prose is not a declaration.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.prunotto.it disallows only /de/; the query-string vintage URLs are allowed. No exception used.
declarations.note: A SECOND ITALIAN PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE ON A PRODUCER'S OWN WORDPRESS, AND IT IS FREE. Prunotto's ?wineyear={year} parameter reaches eight vintages of every wine from the wine's own page, and unlike Cantina Terlan's ?wine-id= archive it is not blocked by robots.txt. After Ricasoli (808 per-vintage URLs) and Terlan and Michele Chiarlo's dated schede, that is the fourth Italian producer with real vintage machinery and no ingredient list — the archive tells you the year and then has nothing to attach to it. Note the corollary for future runs: THE DEFAULT PAGE IS NOT ALWAYS THE SAME VINTAGE FOR TWO WINES OF ONE ESTATE. Prunotto's Fiulot still shows the 2024 while its Moscato has rolled to the 2025, so read the year strip per wine rather than assuming the estate as a whole is on one release.

declarations.name: High On Love Pink Bubbles Prosecco Extra Brut
declarations.evidence: Societa Agricola Antonio Facchin & Figli, Cimadolmo (TV), Veneto — two surfaces, and NEITHER COULD BE READ, for two different reasons, one of them absolute. (1) The webshop www.antoniofacchinshop.it is a Magento behind Cloudflare and answers its own robots.txt-declared sitemap (/sitemaps/antoniofacchin_shop_it_ita.xml) with HTTP 403 carrying the 'Just a moment...' interstitial, header cf-mitigated present, 'Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue'. That is a bot challenge and is absolute under this project's rules: it was not retried and not worked around, and no product URL on that host was requested. (2) The marketing site www.antoniofacchin.com serves robots.txt over Cloudflare but answers HTTP 522 (origin connection timed out) for the site root, and every subsequent path request hung until the wrapper killed it after four minutes. An origin outage, not a refusal. Separately, the Swedish brand HIGH ON LOVE has no surface of its own: it is a Systembolaget-only name (the Swedish supplier is literally 'High On Love Winery'), a web search for it returns Systembolaget and five Swedish resellers and nothing on any Italian domain, and no High On Love domain resolves.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.antoniofacchinshop.it is a stock Magento robots.txt with one 'User-agent: *' group, 'Crawl-Delay: 10' (honoured; only two requests were made to the host, minutes apart) and the sitemap explicitly named — the sitemap URL fetched was allowed, and it is the server that refused, not the file. www.antoniofacchin.com is Cloudflare-managed and has BOTH a 'User-agent: *' group with 'Allow: /' AND ten named AI-crawler groups with 'Disallow: /' (Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, ClaudeBot, CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler, Google-Extended, GPTBot, meta-externalagent). Unlike bpdr.com the wildcard group exists here, so no RFC 9309 reading is needed: we match '*', which allows everything. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: THE PRODUCER'S OWN SHOP IS ALSO A THIRD-PARTY RETAILER, AND ITS robots.txt IS THE CATALOGUE. antoniofacchinshop.it disallows about thirty anchored '/*{brand}$' landing slugs — lorenzonetto, vigneti_zanatta, la_tordera, brugnano, pasqua, borga, la_frassina, tenuta_san_leonardo, ANGELO_NEGRO, chateau_marjosse, rene_bouvier, buzzinelli, degani, meran, cerulli_spinozzi, LE MORETTE, pietro_zanoni and more. That is the same shape as www.shop.rottensteiner.wine, and the same conclusion: the host sells far beyond its owner, two of the brands (Angelo Negro, Le Morette) are in this project's own remaining Italian pool, and it is a source for none of them — a producer's shop that resells is a retailer for everything but its own wine, and it is behind a Cloudflare challenge in any case.

declarations.name: High On Love Bubbles Prosecco Extra dry
declarations.evidence: Same producer, same two surfaces and the same two blocks as product 5751201: the shop answers a Cloudflare bot challenge (403, cf-mitigated) on the one URL its own robots.txt names, and the marketing site answers HTTP 522 on the root and then hangs. No further requests were made to either host. The brand itself has no Italian presence: 'High On Love' returns only Systembolaget and Swedish resellers, which are not sources.
declarations.robots_reasoning: See product 5751201. Both hosts allow us; one refuses technologically and one is down.
declarations.note: REVISIT CANDIDATE, WEAKLY. Both wines are 2025, so the obligation certainly covers them, and the marketing site's 522 is an outage that may clear. But the shop's Cloudflare challenge will not, and the brand looks export-only in the strongest form yet seen — Sweden-only, with the importer's own name registered as the 'producer' of the brand. Do not spend more than two fetches here on a later slice.

declarations.name: Amber One Catarratto
declarations.evidence: Azienda Agricola Rallo, Via V. Florio 2, Marsala (TP) — www.rallo1860.it, WordPress, twenty per-wine pages in IT and EN, NO WEBSHOP OF ANY KIND (the only outbound host on a product page is a Brevo newsletter stylesheet). No wine on the site is named 'Amber One'; the estate's orange Catarratto from Pattipiccolo, Alcamo is AV01, and its 2024 scheda tecnica (/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/AV01_ITA.pdf, Last-Modified 18 June 2026) was downloaded and read in full. THE SHEET IS THE CLOSEST ITALIAN NEAR-MISS THIS PROJECT HAS SEEN AND IT IS STILL NOT A DECLARATION: it prints 'ANNATA 2024', 'Grado alcolico: 13,5%', 'Zuccheri residui: 1,6 g/100 ml', a 'Valori Nutrizionali / Energia (E) per 100 ml: 314 kj / 75 Kcal' block, 'Allergeni: Non contiene solfiti', a full 'Informazioni di Smaltimento' packaging table (Bottiglia vetro GL71, Capsula Gommalacca Indifferenziata, Tappo di Sughero FOR51), the organic certification IT-BIO-007 and a vintage report — AND NO INGREDIENT LIST. There is no 'Ingredienti' line, no list of substances, and the only additive statement is the negative one, 'Vino di matrice naturale privo di solfiti aggiunti'. Under this project's rules a producer page counts only where it presents an actual list of substances, so this is not a source. The two web pages checked (/av01-wine/ and /vini/) carry the same fields minus the nutrition block, and their raw-HTML hits for etichett, elabel and energia are all prose or Iubenda false positives.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.rallo1860.it serves a bare Yoast robots.txt — one 'User-agent: *' group with an empty 'Disallow:' plus a Sitemap line — so nothing is disallowed. www.cantinerallo.it 301s the whole host to www.rallo1860.it and answers robots.txt with the site's own HTML, a soft 404, so it carries no directives either. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: THE IDENTIFICATION WAS NEVER COMPLETED, AND IT DID NOT NEED TO BE. Systembolaget's 'Amber One Catarratto' has no counterpart of that name on the producer's surface; AV01 is the only Catarratto orange wine Rallo makes, and it agrees with Systembolaget on vintage (2024), grape, pack (750 ml) and strength (13,5 % against 13,5) — but it disagrees on the organic flag (the sheet is certified IT-BIO-007 while Systembolaget's item is not marked organic), and 'Amber One' appears nowhere on any Italian domain, only on Vivino, CellarTracker and the Swedish importer Krut & Krut. The export-only-brand rule again. It changes nothing here because the sheet carries no ingredient list either way, but a later run should not treat AV01 as established to be this bottle. A RARE INVERSION WORTH RECOGNISING: this is the first source in the file with the ENERGY VALUE and no ingredient list. The usual Italian near-miss is the reverse (an allergen line, or Demarie's list with no nutrition). An energy figure plus 'Allergeni:' plus a smaltimento table is exactly the set of things Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 lets stay on the physical label, published on the web with the one part that was supposed to move online left out.

declarations.name: Nero Frizzante
declarations.evidence: Same producer and site as product 7851401. THE WINE IS NOT ON THE PRODUCER'S SURFACE AT ALL. Rallo's /vini/ page lists the complete range in four lines — Selezioni (AV01, Beleda, La Cuba, Ghibli), Monovarietali (Bianco Maggiore, La Maggiore, Al Qasar, Evro, Alba Rosea, Il Manto, Regnante, La Clarissa, Lucido), Classici (Il Principe, Carta D'Oro) and Fuori pasto (Soleras, Passito di Pantelleria, Mille, Est. 1969) — and the string 'frizzante' occurs ZERO times on it. declarations.note: Second Rallo wine, second export-only name. Both of this producer's Swedish bottles carry names ('Amber One', 'Nero Frizzante') that exist on Vivino, on wine-searcher and on the Swedish importer's site and on no page the producer controls. Where Saget la Perriere had one export brand across its range, here the two Swedish SKUs are the whole Swedish presence and both are renamed.

declarations.name: Ruminat Primitivo Lunaria Terre di Chieti
declarations.producer: Soc Coop Ag Olearia Vinicola Orsogna
declarations.evidence: BIO Cantina {Sociale} Orsogna / Olearia Vinicola Orsogna, Via Ortonese 29, Orsogna (CH), Abruzzo — a large organic and biodynamic co-op with sixteen brands, and its site www.biocantinaorsogna.it is a WooCommerce whose product sitemap holds 276 products. OUR WINE HAS ITS OWN PRODUCT PAGE, /prodotto/lunaria-ruminat-primitivo/ = 'LUNARIA RUMINAT primitivo', MARCHIO Lunaria, DENOMINAZIONE PRIMITIVO Terre d'Abruzzo IGP, COLORE Rosso, FORMATO 750 ml (also 375 ml), Demeter and Biodiversity Friend, spontaneous fermentation, natural tartaric stabilisation — AND IT STATES NO VINTAGE, no alcohol and no ingredient list. What it does state where a declaration would go is a LIMIT, not a content: 'SOLFITI Limite del vino biodinamico Demeter = vino rosso max 70 mg/lt', plus 'STABILIZZAZIONE TARTARICA Solo refrigerazione naturale' and 'FILTRAZIONE Non ammessa la filtrazione sterile'. A maximum permitted by a certification scheme is not a declaration of what is in this bottle, and the other two lines are the negative-list near-miss (what was not done). Zero occurrences of ingredien, kcal, energia, dichiarazion and ioagri in raw HTML and stripped text; the nutrizion, etichett, elabel and e-label hits are all false positives (see note).
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.biocantinaorsogna.it has three named bad-bot groups (DomainCrawler, SemrushBot, AhrefsBot, each Disallow: /) and a 'User-agent: *' group that disallows only file extensions — /*.jpg, /*.png, /*.pdf, /*.PDF, /*.mp3, /*.mov, /*.avi, /*.csv, /*.data — with Crawl-delay: 2. We match '*', so every HTML page fetched is allowed and NO PDF WAS FETCHED ON THIS HOST; the crawl-delay was honoured. orsognacantina.trusty.report disallows /manage, /whistleblower-login and /password/reset; only the root and robots.txt were requested. www.orsognawinery.com and cantinaorsogna.it both 301 the whole host to www.biocantinaorsogna.it and answer robots.txt with a 404, so they carry no directives. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: THREE THINGS THIS CO-OP TEACHES. (1) A NEW FALSE POSITIVE FOR THE `e-label` GREP: the Qode/QODEF WordPress theme family renders its membership widget with the class `qodef-e-label` — nine raw hits and zero text hits on every product page here. Add it to responsiveLabel, whitelabel, toggle-label, cm-cookie-label, slideLabel, site-nav__link-menu-label, __VIEWSTATE and checkJQuery. (2) A `trusty.report` SUBDOMAIN IS A WHISTLEBLOWING CHANNEL, NOT TRACEABILITY. The estate's Blockchain page links https://orsognacantina.trusty.report/, which under a heading about blockchain traceability looks exactly like a product-passport platform and is in fact Trusty AG's confidential-reporting application ('Benvenuti nel canale di segnalazione'). Recognise the host and do not spend a second fetch on it. (3) NINTH ITALIAN PRODUCER WITH THE PACKAGING OBLIGATION MET AND THE INGREDIENT ONE NOT — and here it is called by its full name: /etichetta-ambientale-digitale-zeropuro-pecorino/, one page per SKU giving BOTTIGLIA GL 70, TAPPO FOR 51, ETICHETTA raccolta indifferenziata and a 'SCHEDA DEL VINO' link, with zero occurrences of ingredien, kcal, energia and solfit. 'Etichetta ambientale DIGITALE' is the most e-label-sounding name the decree has produced yet and it is still the decree.

declarations.name: Charisma Lunaria Trebbiano d`Abruzzo
declarations.producer: Soc Coop Ag Olearia Vinicola Orsogna
declarations.evidence: Same co-op and same WooCommerce as product 7099201. Our wine's page is /prodotto/lunaria-charisma-trebbiano-dabruzzo-dop/ = 'LUNARIA CHARISMA trebbiano d'Abruzzo DOP non filtrato', MARCHIO Lunaria, COLORE Bianco, FORMATO 750 ml, Demeter, fermentazione spontanea, non filtrato. It was read in full and it is the same template as the Ruminat, field for field: NO VINTAGE, no alcohol, no ingredient list, the same Demeter sulphite LIMIT in place of a content, and the same marker profile (ingredien, kcal, energia, dichiarazion all zero in raw HTML and stripped text; the e-label hits are the Qode theme's `qodef-e-label` class).
declarations.robots_reasoning: See product 7099201. HTML pages allowed, PDFs disallowed and not fetched, Crawl-delay: 2 honoured.
declarations.note: A WooCommerce THAT SELLS 276 PRODUCTS AND DATES NONE OF THEM. This is the counter-example to the standing advice that an Italian producer's shop is the surface that declares: Orsogna's shop IS the marketing site, one product per cuvee across sixteen brands, and the product template has no vintage field at all. Where Demarie's WooCommerce had four tabs and an `ingredient-list` panel, this one has two (Descrizione, Premi) and no such class anywhere.

declarations.name: Ambleri Bianco Bio
declarations.evidence: Cantine Ermes Soc. Coop. Agr., Santa Ninfa (TP), Sicilia, P.iva 01887690814 — a very large Sicilian co-op group, WordPress, with an unusually rich sitemap index: separate vino, brand, schede-tecniche, download, sede, territorio and categoria sitemaps. THE BRAND 'AMBLERI' DOES NOT EXIST ON IT. The vino sitemap holds 68 URLs (34 wines in IT and EN) and the brand sitemap names the group's seven consumer brands — Ca' Nomboli, Cademusa, Epicentro, Masseria delle Stelle, No Compromise, Quattro Quarti, Vento di Mare — with zero matches for 'ambleri' in the wine sitemap, the brand sitemap, the schede-tecniche sitemap (70 URLs) or the download sitemap (38 URLs). AND THE CO-OP DECLARES NOTHING FOR ITS OWN BRANDS EITHER: its nearest comparable wine, /brand/vento-di-mare-grillo-bio/ (Grillo Biologico, Sicilia DOC), prints an inline 'Scheda Tecnica' block — Vitigno, Gradazione 12,5%, Denominazione, periodo and tipo di vendemmia, allevamento, terreno, affinamento, chiusura, tasting note, abbinamenti — with NO VINTAGE and no ingredient list, and its /schede-tecniche/grillo/ page renders only navigation and footer. Zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, ingredient-list and ioagri in raw HTML and stripped text on both pages; the dichiarazion and etichett hits are the OneTap accessibility widget's 'Dichiarazione' string and a cookie banner's 'dati dei servizi etichettati'.
declarations.robots_reasoning: cantineermes.it serves two 'User-agent: *' groups — a WPForms block disallowing /wp-content/uploads/wpforms/ and a Yoast block with an empty 'Disallow:' plus the sitemap line. Nothing fetched is in the disallowed path under either reading. No e-label host involved, no exception used.
declarations.note: THE PRIVATE-LABEL CO-OP IS A DISTINCT ITALIAN FAILURE SHAPE AND IT CLOSES IN THREE FETCHES. Cantine Ermes is one of Italy's biggest contract and private-label producers; the Swedish importer Nigab's 'Ambleri' is a label the co-op fills, not a wine it markets, so there is no producer page for it and there never will be. The export-only-brand rule (Saget la Perriere, Rallo) at its logical end: the brand belongs to the importer, not the producer. WHERE THE SITEMAP INDEX NAMES A `brand` POST TYPE, ONE FETCH OF IT IS A COMPLETE CENSUS OF WHAT THE PRODUCER PUTS ITS OWN NAME ON — and if the Swedish name is not there, the wine is closed without opening a product page. Six of the seven Ermes brands (all but Cademusa) also appear on the Swedish shelf under other numbers, so the co-op is worth remembering as a supplier even though it declares nothing.

declarations.name: Gaja Sito Moresco
declarations.evidence: Gaja has no wine website. www.gaja.com is a 2 404-byte single-page black placeholder carrying the logo image, the Barbaresco address, a phone number and mailto:info@gaja.com — eight hrefs in total, all of them CSS, fonts and favicons. declarations.name: Fiano di Avellino Mastroberardino
declarations.evidence: AN E-LABEL EXISTS AND CANNOT BE READ. Step 0 passed: Mastroberardino's own page sitemap names /fiano-avellino-docg-vino-bianco/ and the shop's product sitemap the matching /shop/vino/fiano-avellino-docg-vino-bianco/, so the Swedish name is the producer's own. The marketing page is the usual undated Italian cuvee page (denominazione, vitigno, vigneto, vendemmia, vinificazione, sensory notes, no vintage, no alcohol) and its 'SCARICA BROCHURE' PDF is /wp-content/uploads/2015/11/Fiano di Avellino ITA_.pdf, Last-Modified 10 Nov 2019 by HEAD — predating the obligation, so not downloaded. THE SHOP IS THE SURFACE THAT POINTS AT A DECLARATION: each WooCommerce product page carries a block headed 'Scansiona per: Valori nutrizionali, Ingredienti, Raccolta differenziata' wrapping a QR image in an anchor to https://d.i-wine.app:8444/01/{producer-uuid}-p{product-id}. That URL 302s to https://qr.i-wine.app/01/… and returns a 730-byte React shell with an empty <div id="root"> and one module bundle — client-side rendering, nothing in the server's HTML. A second request with Accept: application/json on the same URL returns the identical shell. No further probing was done: guessing an API route would be enumerating a host, which the e-label exception does not license. The QR image beside the link is named fiano_avellino_2025.png and was uploaded 2026/03, which suggests the current e-label is the 2025 and our bottle the 2024, but that is a file name and not a statement on the page, so nothing was concluded from it.
declarations.robots_reasoning: mastroberardino.com/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /'. The shop's own robots.txt at /shop/ disallows /wp-admin/, /ff-categories/, /ff-projects/ and /categoria-prodotto/; the product pages and sitemaps fetched are outside those paths. d.i-wine.app and qr.i-wine.app answer /robots.txt with HTTP 200 carrying the SPA's own HTML — a soft 404, so no directives exist on either host and no exception was needed.
declarations.note: NEW ITALIAN E-LABEL VENDOR: 'i-wine' / discover-iwine, d.i-wine.app:8444 (note the non-standard port) redirecting to qr.i-wine.app, path /01/{producer-uuid}-p{8-digit product id}. The /01/ segment imitates a GS1 Digital Link but the value is a UUID, not a GTIN. The token is product-keyed and shared across pack variations: the Fiano's 375 ml and 750 ml WooCommerce variations carry the same href. Unreadable as it stands; a revisit candidate only if the vendor ever server-renders.

Its per-wine PDF /pdf/appassimento-it.pdf is Last-Modified 28 Feb 2024, after the obligation, so it was downloaded and its text extracted in full: the same fields as the page, no vintage, no alcohol, no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no sulphite line. Check for a brand-owned domain before closing on absence. Note also that Nardelli's second Appassimento, 'Appassimento Edizione', exists on the same site; Systembolaget's plain 'Appassimento' matches the first, and the distinction did not have to be settled because neither carries a declaration. declarations.name: Rosso di Montalcino Ciacci Piccolomini
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT VINTAGE IS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN PAGE AND CARRIES NO DECLARATION. Step 0 passed: the estate's /it/prodotti/prodotti page lists ten own-name products including both Swedish wines. The Rosso di Montalcino page is a per-vintage archive of 39 years, 1987 to 2024, embedded as a JavaScript array named $schede in the server's HTML — one object per vintage with an 'annata' field and a 'voci' list of labelled fields. The 2024 object was parsed in full: Vigneti, Vitigno (100% Sangiovese), Vinificazione, Colore, Caratteristiche Organolettiche, Servizio, Abbinamento gastronomico and Note tecniche, and nothing else. No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value, no sulphite line and no alcohol figure, for 2024 or any other year. Its only per-vintage document, /files/bottiglie_dowload_2016/ciacci-piccolomini-daragona-rosso-di-montalcino-2024.pdf, was downloaded and read: it is a one-page critic's review card ('90 PTS.') and not a datasheet. The estate's own PrestaShop, www.ciaccipiccolomini-shop.com, sells this exact bottle as product 206, 'Rosso di Montalcino 2024 DOC', reference RS24 — the right wine at the right vintage — and its Product Details holds one line, the grape. Nothing on either host matches ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia or dichiarazion in raw HTML or in stripped text.
declarations.robots_reasoning: ciaccipiccolomini.it serves no robots.txt (404 with an Apache error page), so nothing is disallowed. The shop's PrestaShop robots.txt disallows account, cart, search and framework paths and query strings; the product URL and the storefront root fetched here are outside all of them. No exception used.
declarations.note: A fifth Italian producer with real per-vintage machinery and nothing to hang on it, after Ricasoli, Terlan, Chiarlo and Prunotto — and the deepest archive of them all at 39 vintages. The estate also prints the Decreto Rifiuti packaging table inline on every wine page (bottle GL 71, cork FOR 51, capsule ALU 41), so it is another producer meeting the packaging obligation and not the ingredient one. The archive is worth knowing for its shape: the whole vintage series is in one JS array in one response, so a per-vintage question costs one fetch, not one per year.

declarations.name: Enzo Bartoli Gavi
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT BOTTLE IS ON THE GROUP'S OWN SHOP AND CARRIES NO INGREDIENT LIST. Step 0: MGM S.r.l. is M.G.M. Mondo del Vino, now part of the Argea group, and 'Enzo Bartoli' is a brand it owns and publishes — enzobartoli.it is a first-party site (Argea privacy, careers and whistleblowing links in the footer) with a vino-sitemap of twelve cuvees in two languages, the Gavi DOCG among them. The Argea group shop, shop.argea.com, sells the wine as 'Gavi DOCG — Enzo Bartoli' with a product table reading Annata 2024, Varieta Cortese, Gradazione alcolica 12% vol, Formato 0,75L — matching Systembolaget's 2024, 12,0 % and 750 ml exactly — and where the ingredient list belongs it prints only 'Allergeni: Contiene Solfiti' and 'Provenienza: Prodotto in Italia'. That is the standard Italian two-particular near-miss: no substances, no nutrition table, no energy value. Zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia and dichiarazion in raw HTML as well as stripped text, and no e-label or QR href on the page. The brand site's own cuvee page is undated (ALC. 12% vol with the caveat that it varies by vintage, FORMATO 0,75) and its scheda, /wp-content/uploads/sites/19/2025/08/enzo-bartoli-gavi-docg.pdf, Last-Modified 7 Aug 2025, was downloaded and read in full: territorio, vitigno, identita, in vigna, in cantina, nel calice, a tavola — no vintage, no ingredient list, no nutrition.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.enzobartoli.it answers /robots.txt with the site's own HTML (a soft 404), so no directives exist. shop.argea.com has two User-agent: * groups, one disallowing WooCommerce log and upload paths and /wp-admin/, one empty; the product, brand and sitemap URLs fetched are outside them. No exception used.
declarations.note: ARGEA'S GROUP SHOP IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE TO GIV'S. shop.argea.com is a 185-product first-party WooCommerce covering the group's brands — Botter, Mondo del Vino, Zaccagnini, Ricossa, Cuvage, Poderi dal Nespoli, Barone Montalto, Enzo Bartoli, Mosketto, Asio Otus, Brilla — with an excellent identity block (Annata, Appellazione, Varieta, Gradazione alcolica, Formato) and no ingredient list on any of them. Since Argea supplies a large share of the Italian volume on the Swedish shelf, that one fetch settles the group rather than one wine: expect the near-miss, not a declaration, and check the Annata field only when a wine of theirs comes up again.

declarations.name: Cerasuolo D'Abruzzo Azienda Marramiero
declarations.raw_ingredients: uve, mosto di uve concentrato, Conservanti e antiossidanti ( solfiti ), Antiossidanti (acido L-ascorbico), Imbottigliato in atmosfera protettiva
declarations.evidence: A THIRD-PARTY E-LABEL THAT PUBLISHES ONE DECLARATION PER VINTAGE. Step 0 passed: marramiero.it is the estate's own WooCommerce and its product sitemap names both Swedish wines under the estate's own names. Every product page carries an anchor reading 'Valori nutrizionali' with class btn-nutrizionale, pointing at https://ead-qr.com/p/{id} — Giunko Srl's 'Etichetta Digitale', server-rendered plain HTML. The page for this wine is headed 'Prima Linea Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo DOC 0,75' and names 'Azienda Marramiero S.R.L.' as the responsible company, and it carries TWO SEPARATE BLOCKS, each labelled with its year: 'Valori Nutrizionali 2024' / 'Ingredienti 2024' and 'Valori Nutrizionali 2025' / 'Ingredienti 2025'. The 2024 block is quoted above; it differs from the 2025 (which reads 'uve, Agenti stabilizzanti (acido citrico), Conservanti e antiossidanti ( solfiti ), Imbottigliato in atmosfera protettiva'), so the two years are genuinely two recipes and the vintage rule is satisfied by the source's own labelling rather than by inference. Nutrition for 2024: Energia 306 kJ / 73 kcal, Grassi 0 g, Carboidrati 0,43 g di cui zuccheri 0,33 g, Proteine 0 g, Sale 0 g per 100 ml. Identity: the e-label links the producer's own product card, /wp-content/uploads/SCHEDE-PRODOTTO/EN/Product-card-CERASUOLO.pdf, which states 'Rose wine', 'ALCOHOL CONTENT 12,50% vol.' and '75 cl CERASUOLO / CERASUOLO D'ABRUZZO D.O.C.' — matching Systembolaget's 12,5 %, 750 ml and rose exactly. The estate's only other Cerasuolo is the Selezioni 'Colle Sant'Andrea Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo Colline Pescaresi Superiore', a separately named cuvee that is sold out, has no e-label link and no product card; Systembolaget's plain name and this line's strength both point at the Prima Linea. Language: the e-label offers a 25-language EU selector including Svenska; the Italian version was taken with an Accept-Language header on the same URL and is quoted verbatim. NOTE THAT THE PRODUCER'S OWN SHOP HAS ROLLED ON — its Annata attribute reads 2025 — so this find exists only because the e-label keeps both years side by side.
declarations.robots_reasoning: marramiero.it has two User-agent: * groups, one disallowing WooCommerce log and upload paths and add-to-cart query strings, one empty; the product pages, sitemaps and the SCHEDE-PRODOTTO PDF are outside them. ead-qr.com serves no robots.txt at all — a genuine 404 with a plain text body, not a soft 404 — so nothing is disallowed there and no exception was needed.
declarations.note: NEW ITALIAN E-LABEL VENDOR AND THE BEST-BEHAVED ONE SEEN ANYWHERE: Giunko Srl (Bologna), ead-qr.com/p/{numeric id}, reached from an anchor reading 'Valori nutrizionali' with class btn-nutrizionale. Server-rendered, ~38 kB, 25-language EU selector driven by the Accept-Language header on the same URL, the environmental label and the ingredient declaration on one page, and — uniquely in this project — SEPARATE, EXPLICITLY YEAR-LABELLED INGREDIENT AND NUTRITION BLOCKS FOR EACH VINTAGE STILL ON THE MARKET. That solves the failure mode that has cost this project more rejections than any other. Ids are per product and consecutive across an estate's range (1890568, 1890569), which is not a licence to enumerate: each was taken from its own product page.

declarations.name: Zamò Bianco
declarations.evidence: THE ESTATE'S SITE DOES NOT ANSWER. Step 0 could not be run on the producer's own surface. www.zamo.it is not the estate — it is ZAMO Srl, a maker of hydraulic breakers in Basilicata, a Joomla catalogue of demolition hammers from 60 to 1300 kg — the surname trap again after sartori.it, castellani.it and hermouet.fr. The estate's own domain is levignedizamo.com, and it is unreachable from here in every form tried: the apex refuses the connection on 443 (213.186.33.5, an OVH address) and times out on 80, and www.levignedizamo.com (31.193.131.44) times out at the TCP level over httpx and over curl -4 with a 30 s limit. declarations.evidence: MASI HAS ADOPTED AN E-LABEL PLATFORM, THE E-LABEL IS FOR EXACTLY THIS BOTTLE, AND IT CANNOT BE READ. Step 0: Masi Agricola S.p.A., Via Monteleone 26, Gargagnago di Valpolicella (VR), P.IVA 03546810239 — Systembolaget's 'Masi', and Levarìe is its own Soave Classico DOC. Decoded offline with OpenCV (no network; the image needed a white quiet-zone border and a downscale before it would detect) it reads https://label.masi.it/qr/LevarieMasi. Scantrust is already recorded in this project as unreadable by construction: the uid and api_key sit in the URL FRAGMENT, which a browser never sends to the server, so no server response can contain the declaration, and the api_key is a per-request signed token — an issued token, which the agent's rules treat as absolute. Nothing was worked around and no JS bundle was mined. No declaration was read, so nothing is recorded.

No exception was needed anywhere, and the Scantrust fetch was a single request to a URL the producer's own product page publishes.
declarations.note: AND THE QR IS NOT PER VINTAGE. The 2025 Levarìe product page carries the IDENTICAL icon URL (1715770531-levarie.png) and therefore the identical Scantrust destination, so one e-label serves both vintages. Even if Scantrust ever became readable, this wine could not be attached on the producer's linking alone — the page would have to state its own year. Recorded so a later run does not spend the fetch twice.
declarations.revisit: Low value. The platform cannot serve the declaration from the server, and the slug is shared across vintages.

declarations.name: Planeta Chardonnay
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT VINTAGE IS DOCUMENTED, IN A PER-VINTAGE DATASHEET, AND THERE IS NO INGREDIENT LIST IN IT. Step 0: Planeta is Systembolaget's producer and planeta.it is its own WordPress; its sitemap index names eight post types — post, page, experience, oil, territory, wine, category, wine_cellar — and NO label or etichette tree, which closes the vendor question at one fetch. The page is the ordinary undated Italian cuvée page — denominazione Menfi D.O.C., varietà 100% Chardonnay, vigneti Ulmo and Maroccoli, 'Prima Annata 1994' (the estate's first vintage, not this bottling), Vino bio and SOStain badges — plus a full 'Come smaltire gli imballaggi' packaging block (bottle GL71, capsule TIN 42, cork FOR 51). Its one per-wine document is 'Download scheda tecnica' → storage1368.cdn-immedia.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Planeta_Chardonnay-2024-BIO-2.pdf, LAST-MODIFIED 6 March 2026, and its file name carries our exact vintage and the organic designation. (matching Systembolaget's 13,0 exactly), total acidity 5,50 g/l, pH 3,33, ageing potential, the four bottle formats including 0,75 l, the bottle weight and the cork — and zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia, solfit, allergen or dichiarazion. declarations.name: Ciù Ciù di Bartolomei Grande Sangiovese
declarations.evidence:
THE PRODUCER'S HOST WOULD NOT SERVE ANY CONTENT, SO STEP 0 COULD NOT BE RUN. Ciù Ciù di Bartolomei is an Offida (AP) organic estate in the Marche and www.ciuciuvini.it is its site. Its robots.txt answered 200 and named two sitemaps — /sitemapindex.xml and /sitemap.xml.gz — and BOTH answered HTTP 503 'Service Unavailable' with a 468-byte Apache error page, as did the home page (503, 339 bytes). So the host is alive and answering robots.txt while refusing every content path. That is a server-side error, not a technological refusal: no 401, 403 or 429 and no bot challenge was seen, so nothing was worked around and, per the crawling rules, the host was not retried in a loop. Two alternative hosts were tried once each and neither exists: www.ciuciu.it and shop.ciuciuvini.it both fail at connection level. No producer page could be read, no vendor grep could be run and no declaration could be looked for. REVISITED 2026-08-30 (tenth Italian batch). THE OUTAGE IS OVER AND THE PRODUCER IS STILL UNREADABLE, FOR A DIFFERENT REASON. robots.txt, the sitemap index, post_vini.xml and the WordPress search now all answer 200 with real content, so the seventh batch's blanket 503 has gone. But EVERY PAGE UNDER /vini/ — each of the 18 wine URLs the sitemap names, and the range pages above them — returns exactly 6 526 bytes consisting of PHP Notice/Warning/Deprecated lines and a run of
tags, with no wine content at all. The whole site is running a broken WordPress with display_errors on ('Trying to access array offset on value of type bool in .../wp-includes/plugin.php on line 211', repeated dozens of times, plus 'Cannot modify header information - headers already sent'); the home and search templates survive it and the wine post-type template does not. So no per-wine page could be read, no vendor grep could be run, and the declaration question is still unanswered for this producer. STEP 0 ALSO FAILS INDEPENDENTLY, WHICH IS NEW: post_vini.xml names the estate's whole range — rosato, lazio-i-g-p-sauvignon, alta-marea, merlettaie-brut, esperanto, rymarose, oppidum, arbinus, saggio, tebaldo, evoe, oris, bacchus, san-carro, gotico, merlettaie, lacrima-di-morro-dalba — and there is NO cuvee called Grande Sangiovese among them. A site search for 'sangiovese' returns one result, the Rymarose sparkling. Systembolaget's 'Ciu Ciu di Bartolomei Grande Sangiovese' (Marche, Sangiovese and Montepulciano, 13,5 %, organic) therefore has no matching page in the producer's own catalogue even in principle, so a declaration found on any of the 18 could not have been attributed to it. AND THE ALTERNATIVE HOSTS DO NOT EXIST: the seventh batch read shop.ciuciuvini.it's failure as a connection refusal, but the real reason is that ciuciuvini.it, ciuciu.it and ciuciuvini.com all run WILDCARD DNS — randomxyz123.ciuciuvini.it resolves to the same address as the 'shop' — so a resolving subdomain there is no evidence of a host. The nonsense-subdomain control settled it without a single HTTP request.
sources_checked: REVISIT 2026-08-30 (tenth batch). https://www.ciuciuvini.it/robots.txt (200, and now a real body: the stock WordPress 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/' plus two Sitemap lines, buried in ~6 kB of PHP Notice/Warning output)
https://www.ciuciuvini.it/?s=sangiovese (200, renders) — the step-0 site-search probe
https://www.ciuciuvini.it/vini/vini-rossi/esperanto (200, 6 526 bytes, PHP notices and nothing else)

DNS: shop.ciuciuvini.it and store.ciuciuvini.it appear to resolve but ciuciuvini.it has WILDCARD DNS — randomxyz123.ciuciuvini.it resolves to the same 81.31.158.5 — so neither host exists. ciuciu.it and ciuciuvini.com are wildcarded too and https://www.ciuciu.it/ answers 'No route to host'. ciuciu.wine is NXDOMAIN.
declarations.robots_reasoning: www.ciuciuvini.it/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/' and allows everything else. Nothing disallowed was fetched and no exception was used.
declarations.note: A HOST THAT SERVES robots.txt AND 503s EVERYTHING ELSE IS A NEW FAILURE SHAPE IN THIS FILE — different from Le Vigne di Zamò, where the host did not answer at all. Whether it is maintenance or a WAF that lets static files through and rejects PHP could not be determined from one pass, and determining it would have meant repeated requests.

Our token, vindeklaration/0.1, matches neither named group; under RFC 9309 a group binds only the tokens it names, so with no matching group and no wildcard fallback no rule applies and nothing is disallowed. declarations.note: THE HOST SERVES AN INCOMPLETE TLS CHAIN. www.terredelbarolo.com and terredelbarolo.com present the leaf certificate (CN=terredelbarolo.com, Sectigo DV R36) WITHOUT the intermediate, so an ordinary verifying client fails with 'unable to get local issuer certificate'. IVA 01897140743' — the shop is the producer's own property, so this is first-party publishing and not a retailer. THE CUVÉE TOOK WORK, AND THE ORGANIC FLAG DECIDED IT. The WooCommerce product carries four tabs — Scheda Tecnica, Valori Nutrizionali, Ingredienti, Smaltimento — all server-rendered. The Ingredienti panel is a label/value table quoted verbatim in raw_ingredients; the '0' values are the shop's empty-field default and mean the category is not used, and 'Solfiti' is wrapped in <span class="attenzione"> because the panel's footnote says allergens are printed in red bold. The nutrition panel gives, per 100 ml: Energia 83,5/349,5 Kcal/KJ, Grassi 0 g, Di cui acidi grassi saturi 0 g, Carboidrati 2,7 g, Di cui zuccheri 0 g, Fibre 0 g, Proteine 0 g, Sale 0 g. A vintage mismatch is a rejection, not an approximation; the declaration is quoted in full here so that if the shop's Organico rolls to the 2024 the wine attaches without a refetch. declarations.note: A NEW GREP LIE, AND IT DEGRADES ONE OF THE STANDARD TERMS. 'kJ' matched 60-65 times raw on every Cecchi page and EVERY hit is inside inline base64 (images and fonts) — 'wTCb+Jqso4qpKj2uH1WBiMMI', 'oPOqF+jHkI0HkJr0mXMag60R' and so on. Base64 is a 64-symbol alphabet, so a two-character sequence turns up roughly once per 4 000 characters; any page with an inline data URI will show dozens of raw kJ hits.
