Schenk Italia S.p.A., Via Stazione 43, I-39040 Ora (Bolzano), P.IVA 00122400211, owns the Lunadoro estate at Valiano di Montepulciano (Società Agricola Lunadoro S.r.l., P.I. 01425800529), and lunadoro.it's own footer links schenkitalia.it, so the two hosts are one company's. STEP 0 IS THE FINDING. Systembolaget's item is 'Lunadoro Rosso di Montepulciano Organic', organic, 13,0 % vol. Lunadoro's own /i-vini/ page lists exactly four wines — Prugnanello Rosso di Montepulciano, Pagliareto, Gran Pagliareto and Quercione — and Schenk's 112-URL Italian wine sitemap holds six Montepulciano wines and adds only Doppio Lustro. THERE IS NO ORGANIC ROSSO DI MONTEPULCIANO ON EITHER SURFACE. The nearest match, Prugnanello Rosso di Montepulciano DOC, is described on both hosts with 'Alcohol 14%' against Systembolaget's 13,0 — 1,0 pp, twice the tolerance — and neither page nor its datasheet mentions organic certification at all (zero matches for 'biolog' and 'organic'). So the Swedish bottling could not have been matched even against a declaration. AND THERE IS NO DECLARATION TO MATCH IT AGAINST. Lunadoro's per-wine pages are empty single-post templates rendering only header and footer (15 kB of HTML, 373 bytes of text); the range page /i-vini/ carries four undated cuvée descriptions with a PDF each. The Prugnanello techsheet was fetched and read in full — /wp-content/uploads/2016/08/prugnanello-rosso-di-montepulciano-doc-techsheet-1.pdf, Last-Modified 18 February 2026, 416 186 bytes, one page, bilingual it/en — and it gives vinification, characteristics, pairings, 'Sangiovese', 'Toscana', '16-18 °C', 'Alcol: 14%' and an EMPTY 'Zuccheri: g/l', with zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, allergen and annata. Schenk's own wine page repeats it. THE GROUP'S PAGE SITEMAP IS TEN URLs — home, origins, contacts, zero-alcohol and sustainability in two languages — so there is no transparency or e-label hub anywhere on the group host either. Greps on both hosts for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, ingredient-list, ioagri, ead-qr, i-wine, carmaqrcode and btn-nutrizional are zero.

declarations.robots_reasoning: www.lunadoro.it serves the stock WordPress block ('User-agent: *', 'Disallow: /wp-admin/', 'Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php'). www.schenkitalia.it serves two consecutive 'User-agent: *' groups — the first disallowing /wordpress/wp-admin/, the second the Yoast block with an EMPTY Disallow. declarations.note: TWO THINGS WORTH CARRYING. (1) A WORDPRESS CUSTOM POST TYPE CAN BE IN THE SITEMAP AND RENDER NOTHING: lunadoro.it's four 'wine' posts each return a complete page with header, menu and footer and no content whatsoever — the range page /i-vini/ holds all four descriptions instead. A near-empty per-wine page is not necessarily client-side rendering; check the range page before concluding the site is unreadable. (2) The group's estate brand is the third Italian case in this file where the Swedish item names a bottling absent from the producer's catalogue — but this one is not an export label. It is the same wine with an organic certification and a different strength, which is a subtler version of the same problem and just as fatal to matching.

declarations.name: Terrazze della Luna Pinot Grigio Rosato
declarations.evidence: THE BRAND IS THE PRODUCER'S BEYOND DOUBT AND THE PRODUCER'S OWN CATALOGUE DOES NOT CONTAIN IT. Cavit s.c. (Cantina Viticoltori del Trentino, Trento) is one of Italy's largest cooperative groups. STEP 0, RUN BOTH WAYS: its 'vino' sitemap holds 110 per-wine URLs in Italian and English and its 'linea' sitemap holds all fourteen of its lines — Altemasi, Il Maso, Trentini Premium, Bottega Vinai, Mastri Vernacoli, Spumanti Charmat, Vini Dolci — and NONE of them is Terrazze della Luna. The brand is nonetheless unmistakably Cavit's: the co-op's own site search returns five of its own news and event posts naming it in the first person, including 'Trentodoc Altemasi Millesimato 2021, Bottega Vinai Trentino DOC Sauvignon Blanc 2024 e Terrazze della Luna Trentino DOC Pinot Grigio 2024 hanno ottenuto la medaglia d'argento' and 'abbiamo ottenuto la medaglia d'ORO per i nostri Trentino DOC Pinot Grigio 2021 Mastri Vernacoli e Trentino DOC Pinot Grigio 2021 Terrazze della Luna'. So this is not an importer's label and not a near-name — it is a Cavit brand that the co-op advertises and does not catalogue. THE BRAND HAS NO DOMAIN OF ITS OWN: terrazzedellaluna.it, www.terrazzedellaluna.it and terrazzedellaluna.com are all NXDOMAIN, so the Tagaro/Nardelli check was run and came back empty. AND THERE IS NO DECLARATION SURFACE ANYWHERE ON THE HOST. The page sitemap is twenty Italian URLs — company, viticulture, sustainability, Trentodoc, events, the enoteca, careers, four privacy notices, a login and a web-accessibility statement — and not one is a transparency, etichetta, e-label or ingredient page. There is no product page for any Terrazze della Luna wine, let alone for a Pinot Grigio Rosato 2025, so no vintage, no pack and no strength could be matched even if a declaration existed.

declarations.note: A FOURTH VARIANT OF THE ITALIAN STEP-0 FAILURE, AND THE CLEANEST STATEMENT OF IT YET. Until now a Swedish name absent from the producer's catalogue meant one of three things: an importer's private label (Gheppio/Budbreak), an export-only brand the house does not sell at home (Pasqua's Mucchietto), or a brand on a second domain (Tagaro's Nardelli). This is a fourth: a brand the producer OWNS AND PUBLICLY CLAIMS in its own news, on the same site, while giving it no product page. The co-op's site search is what settles it, and it cost one request — run '?s={brand}' before concluding a name is not the producer's, because the sitemap alone would have said the opposite of the truth here.

declarations.name: Terre More Cabernet
declarations.evidence: THE STRONGEST IDENTITY MATCH IN THE ITALIAN FILE SO FAR, AND STILL NO DECLARATION. Step 0 passes without doubt: Marchesi Frescobaldi's own site catalogues Terre More at /it/vini/terre-more as 'Frescobaldi, Tenuta Ammiraglia, Maremma Toscana Cabernet DOC', which is exactly Systembolaget's 'Terre More Cabernet'. The page is per-vintage — a selector offering 2024 back to 2009 — and its 2024 view states 'Grado Alcolico : 12,5%', matching Systembolaget's 12,5 % exactly, plus the 2024 growing season month by month ('L'annata 2024 alla Tenuta Ammiraglia e stata caratterizzata da un inverno particolarmente mite'). The producer, the cuvee, the vintage and the strength therefore all match. THE DECLARATION IS NOT THERE. The wine page's raw HTML carries zero hits for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, dichiarazion, ingredient-list, ioagri, ead-qr, i-wine, carmaqrcode, u-label, btn-nutrizional and tab-ingredienti; its one 'energia' hit is a route name (il-bosco-il-legno-lenergia) and its three 'etichett' hits are the UI label for the label image download and a news headline. THE PER-VINTAGE PDF WAS FETCHED AND SETTLES IT: https://www.frescobaldi.com/it/pdf/terre-more/2024 (83 kB, application/pdf) is 'Terre More 2024, Formati 0,75 l, Maremma Toscana Cabernet DOC' and its full extracted text contains Andamento climatico, Note tecniche (Varieta, Grado Alcolico 12,5%, Maturazione), Vinificazione e maturazione and Note degustative — and zero occurrences of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, allergen or dichiarazion. Not even a sulphite line. AND THERE IS NO DECLARATION SURFACE ANYWHERE ON THE HOST: the Italian sitemap holds 779 URLs and not one contains nutri, ingred, qr, elabel, e-label, trasparen or smaltim; the only 'etichet' URL is a news post about label design. The site does route a /howtorecycle page, so the packaging side is served and the ingredient side is not. robots.txt allows everything but admin, cart and account paths.

declarations.name: Ruffino Chianti
declarations.evidence: NO PRODUCER SOURCE — AND THE DECLARATION ALREADY EXISTS UPSTREAM FOR THE SIBLING PACK, WHICH IS THE REAL FINDING HERE. Systembolaget's 231002 is the 375 ml of Ruffino Chianti 2025, organic, 12,5 %. Its 750 ml twin, 231001, is the SAME wine, SAME vintage, SAME strength and SAME organic flag and IS declared on Systembolaget's own page ('Druvor, stabiliseringsmedel (gummi arabicum), surhetsreglerande medel (vinsyra (L(+)-)), konserveringsmedel (SULFITER)...'). That text is Systembolaget's transcription of another product number and is deliberately NOT copied into this file — this file only holds producer sources, and a pack-sibling gap belongs to the nightly pipeline to close, not to a hand-matched second source. Recorded as not_found so a later run does not re-probe the producer. STEP 0 FAILS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SITE ANYWAY: ruffino.com 301s to ruffino.it, a Shopify storefront whose Italian product sitemap holds nineteen wines, and the only Chianti DOCG among them is /it/products/chianti — which is the '1877' Chianti, an undated cuvee page ('la cui prima annata risale al 1877', no Annata, no vintage, no alcohol figure) whose only download is an image-only PDF from which no text can be extracted. The estate's own search returns ZERO results for both 'biologico' and 'organic' across the whole catalogue, so Ruffino's Italian site does not catalogue an organic Chianti at all and the Swedish bottle cannot be matched to any page on it. NO DECLARATION SURFACE ON THE HOST: the product page has zero raw hits for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, dichiarazion, u-label, ead-qr, ioagri, i-wine, carmaqrcode, ingredient-list, btn-nutrizional and tab-ingredienti, and the 45-URL page sitemap holds no etichetta, e-label, transparency or ingredient page. robots.txt is Shopify's stock storefront file: products, collections and pages explicitly Allow, only cart, checkout, account and filter traps disallowed.

(1) PRODUCER: the e-label host's footer reads 'Rocca delle Macie S.p.A. | P.iva 00209800523', the same VAT number printed in the wineclub shop's own footer, and the page's Quality Manager contact is gorelli@roccadellemacie.com. HOW IT WAS REACHED, which is the reusable part: the estate's page-sitemap.xml names no per-wine post type at all, and the /vini/ pages are only linked from /tutti-i-prodotti/. The wine page itself carries no declaration and no e-label link — the pointer is on the SHOP, in the product description's last paragraph, as plain text and not an anchor: 'Per informazioni su Etichetta ambientale, lista ingredienti e tabella nutrizionale clicca qui: https://qualitaroccadellemacie.it/chianti-classico-docg/'. Alcolica: 13,5% vol.' where Systembolaget says 13,0 — exactly 0,5 pp, at the tolerance and not over it, and within the EU labelling tolerance of +/- 0,5 % vol. sources_checked: DNS: damilanovini.com does not resolve; damilano.com resolves to 23.227.38.65 (Shopify)

https://cantinedamilano.it/robots.txt re-read 2026-08-29 in the tenth batch: STILL 500, the same Apache default error body. The precondition for the revisit does not hold and no page on the host was requested.
declarations.robots_reasoning: NOT FETCHED, AND THIS IS THE REASON. cantinedamilano.it answers /robots.txt with a 500 Internal Server Error — an Apache default error body, identically on the apex, on www and over plain http, so it is not a transient blip on one edge. RFC 9309 section 2.3.1.4, 'Unreachable Status': 'If the robots.txt file is unreachable due to server or network errors, this means the robots.txt file is undefined and the crawler MUST assume complete disallow', with 500-599 named as the HTTP case. No page on the host was requested. The 2026-07-30 e-label exception does not reach this: it covers a page that is itself the regulated disclosure, and no e-label URL for this producer is held — an ordinary marketing site keeps its robots.txt in full, and an undefined robots.txt is stricter than a permissive one, not looser. This is a policy question worth the owner's attention rather than a finder's: a 5xx robots.txt is a misconfiguration and not a refusal, but the RFC's requirement is unambiguous and inventing an exception is not this agent's to make.
declarations.evidence: CLOSED WITHOUT FETCHING A PAGE, ON ROBOTS.TXT ALONE — see robots_reasoning. What was established before that point is worth recording so a later run does not repeat it. THE DOMAIN IS A NEAR-NAME TRAP OF THE KIND THE SEVENTH BATCH FOUND AT MUCCHIETTO.IT: damilano.com resolves and is a live Shopify storefront, and it is a LEATHER GOODS BRAND — its product sitemap's first thousand URLs are wallets, belts, card cases and luggage tags ('cognac-signato-ladies-wallet', 'croco-leather-coaster-black'). Not one wine. damilanovini.com does not resolve at all. The winery is cantinedamilano.it, the Barolo estate at Cannubi founded 1890 as Borgogno and renamed for Giacomo Damilano in 1935. THE CUVEE WOULD ALSO HAVE NEEDED CARE: the estate makes TWO Barbera d'Asti DOCG, a plain one and a 'ZeroSette', with separate pages (/en/wines/barbera-dasti-docg/ and /en/wines/barbera-dasti-docg-zerosette/). Systembolaget's item is the plain 'Damilano Barbera d'Asti', 14,5 % vol, 750 ml, 2024, so the ZeroSette would have been the wrong bottle. Nothing is known about whether either page carries a declaration and nothing should be assumed: this is not_found because the host could not be read, not because the producer publishes nothing. sources_checked: https://valdibella.com/robots.txt (200, only 'User-agent: MSNBot' and 'User-agent: bingbot' groups, each a Crawl-delay, no Disallow anywhere, no wildcard group)
https://valdibella.com/sitemap_index.xml (twelve children) and product-sitemap.xml (411 URLs across it/en/de/fr)
https://valdibella.com/prodotto/catarratto-metodo-classico/ (200) — a second wine, to see whether the shop's declaration fields are ever populated
declarations.robots_reasoning: valdibella.com's robots.txt names only MSNBot and bingbot, each with a Crawl-delay and no Disallow, and has no 'User-agent: *' group. Under RFC 9309 a group binds only the tokens it names; our token 'vindeklaration/…' matches neither and there is no wildcard fallback, so no rule applies and nothing is disallowed. That is the reading settled on 2026-08-08 (bpdr.com) and applied here without re-litigating it. No exception was needed.
declarations.evidence: THE SHOP HAS THE DECLARATION FIELDS AND HAS LEFT THEM EMPTY — ITALY'S FIRST CLEAR CASE OF ADOPTION WITHOUT PUBLICATION ON A FIRST-PARTY SHOP. Valdibella is the Camporeale (PA) organic co-operative, P.IVA IT 02556740823, and Ariddu is its Grillo Sicilia DOC; the estate's product sitemap lists it as /prodotto/ariddu/ with en, de and fr twins, so the cuvée and the producer are right. STEP 2 CLOSES THE WINE ANYWAY: the page states no vintage. It gives Zona di origine, Vitigno, Altitudine, harvest, Vinificazione, Affinamento, Caratteristiche organolettiche, serving temperature and 'Formati disponibili: casse con 6 bottiglie da 0,75 l' — and no year and no alcohol, so it could not have been vintage-matched or strength-matched against Systembolaget's 2024 at 12,3 % even had a list appeared. THE INTERESTING PART IS IN THE RAW HTML AND IT IS A NEW PROBE: the gtm4wp dataLayer payload embedded in every product page exposes the product's WooCommerce custom fields by name, and they are exactly the mandated set — `"allergeni":""`, `"grado_alcolico":""`, `"origine_e_certificazione":""`, `"ingredienti":""`, `"valori_nutrizionali":""`, plus `modalita_di_impiego`, `contenuto_della_scatola`, `peso_netto` and `condizioni_di_conservazione`. EVERY ONE IS AN EMPTY STRING. The rendered page has the matching 'Specifiche prodotto' tab and it is blank. A SECOND WINE WAS CHECKED AND IS IDENTICAL: /prodotto/catarratto-metodo-classico/ carries the same nine field names, all empty. So this is not one unfinished product — the co-operative has installed the fields for its whole wine range and filled none of them. (The product's meta description is still 'Lorem ipsum…', which says something about how finished the wine pages are.) NO OTHER SURFACE: the raw greps for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazion, annata, etichett, elabel, valori, qr and every vendor token (ioagri, ead-qr, i-wine, carmaqrcode, u-label, btn-nutrizional, tab-ingredienti, goalstec) match nothing outside that empty-field payload, and the only third-party hosts are Google, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X, Brevo, WonderPush and unpkg. Recorded not_found: the fields being empty is evidence about this website, not proof that Valdibella publishes nothing behind a QR code on the bottle.

declarations.evidence: THE IDENTITY IS AS GOOD AS IT EVER GETS IN ITALY AND THERE IS STILL NO DECLARATION. Systembolaget sells 'Feudo di Mezzo Etna Rosso Contrada' 2024, Sicily, 13,5 %, 75 cl. Planeta's own per-wine page is /vini/etna-rosso-contrada-feudo-di-mezzo/ (Etna DOC, Nerello Mascalese and Nerello Cappuccio, Castiglione di Sicilia, cantina Feudo di Mezzo), and the wine's technical sheet is filed per vintage under a name that carries the year: Planeta_Etna-Rosso-Contrada-Feudo-di-Mezzo-2024-BIO.pdf. THAT PDF WAS DOWNLOADED AND ITS TEXT EXTRACTED IN FULL. It is headed 'Etna Rosso Contrada Feudo di Mezzo 2024', states 'GRADAZIONE ALCOLICA: 13,5% vol.' — matching Systembolaget exactly — 'FORMATO BOTTIGLIA: 0,75 l', 'PRIMO IMBOTTIGLIAMENTO: luglio 2025', a 'NOTE DI VENDEMMIA - ETNA 2024' paragraph, and the certifications Vino Biologico and SOStain. So the producer, the cuvee, the contrada, the vintage, the strength and the pack are all confirmed against a producer document written for this bottling. AND IT IS A SCHEDA TECNICA, NOT A DECLARATION: soil, altitude, yield, training system, cultivation method, harvest dates, vinification, ageing, total acidity 5,8 g/l, pH 3,43, bottle weight, closure, tasting note, food pairing. NO INGREDIENT LIST AND NO ENERGY VALUE. THE PACKAGING OBLIGATION IS ON THE WEB PAGE AND THE INGREDIENT ONE IS NOT — the fifth Italian producer in this file to do exactly that. The wine page carries a 'Come smaltire gli imballaggi' block giving bottle GL71 glass, capsule C/ALU 90, cap LDPE 4 and cork FOR 51 with the bin for each, and nothing about what is in the wine. Raw and stripped greps of the page return zero for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia and dichiarazione, and zero for every Italian vendor token (ioagri, ead-qr, i-wine, carmaqrcode, goalstec, u-label.com, btn-nutrizional, tab-ingredienti, qualita). STEP 4 WAS RUN AND THE SHOP DOES NOT DECLARE EITHER. Planeta's wine club Repertorio 1694 (repertorio1694.it) is a genuine first-party e-commerce, 164 URLs, and it sells this exact wine at /product/35653763/... with a VINTAGE selector currently on '24' and a MERCATO (market) selector — the product's variant array is literally keyed {"ANNATA":..., "MERCATO":...}, which is the best per-vintage AND per-market control seen on an Italian shop. Its four tabs are Details, Characteristics, an untitled Tab and Technical data; none is an ingredient tab and the page has zero matches for every declaration term. TWO SMALLER THINGS WORTH THE RECORD: the shop states 'ALCOHOL CONTENT 14%' where the producer's own 2024 scheda says 13,5 % vol and Systembolaget says 13,5 — so the marketing surface agrees with Systembolaget exactly and the shop is the one that disagrees, by 0,5 pp; and the shop's 'Download the technical data sheet' link points at the 2023 PDF while the marketing site links the 2024, so a producer's own links are stale in one direction and current in the other, as at Ricasoli.

The producer is right — Tenute Lunelli Societa Agricola Srl, the Lunelli family's still-wine arm — and the cuvee is right: Pietragrande, Vigneti delle Dolomiti IGT, is one of Tenuta Margon's three Trentino wines and has its own page. It gives Uve (Chardonnay 80 %, Sauvignon, Incrocio Manzoni and Pinot Bianco 20 %), Zona di Produzione, Tipologia dei terreni, Sistema di allevamento, Produzione ha, Temperatura di fermentazione, Affinamento and 'Prima annata di Produzione 2013' — a first vintage, not this bottling's vintage — and no alcohol and no pack. It could not have been vintage-matched even if a list had appeared on it. AND THE MACHINERY TO DATE IT EXISTS AND IS EMPTY: the page carries a div class="annate" headed 'Le annate piu recenti' with a close button and NOTHING INSIDE IT. The template supports a per-vintage list of technical sheets and the estate has published none, so the vintage archive is a hollow shell rather than an absence of design — the Valdibella pattern (fields installed, fields empty) in a different technology. THE ONE SCHEDA TECNICA IS PRE-OBLIGATION AND WAS NOT DOWNLOADED. Its URL carries no vintage and sits under /wp/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/. Per the ninth batch's rule the path alone is not enough, so a HEAD was sent: 'last-modified: Wed, 16 Dec 2020 11:36:36 GMT'. That is three years before 8 December 2023, so the file cannot carry a declaration under Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 and the wine closes with no download — step 5 working exactly as written, as at Sella & Mosca. NO OTHER SURFACE. The estate has no shop, no sitemap and no per-wine post type; the whole site is about twenty hand-built PHP pages and the only PDFs it links besides the schede are two GDPR notices and a code of ethics. Raw and stripped greps of the range page and the wine page return zero for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazione and for every Italian vendor token. THE GROUP'S CONSUMER SITE DOES NOT SELL IT EITHER: shop.ferraritrento.com does not exist, and a site search on www.ferraritrento.com for 'pietragrande' returns sixteen hits that are all news posts — the group's public site is about the sparkling wines and lists no still-wine products at all, so step 4 has no surface here.

declarations.evidence: STEP 2 CLOSES IT AND STEP 5 CONFIRMS THE CLOSE FOR ONE HEAD. Systembolaget sells 'Etna Bianco Benanti' 2024, Sicily, 12,0 %, 75 cl. Benanti Viticoltori S.r.l., P.iva 07884420964, is the right producer and 'Etna Bianco' is a real cuvee in its Tradizionali range with its own page — and the estate makes THREE other Etna Biancos (Pietra Marina Etna Bianco Superiore, Contrada Rinazzo Etna Bianco Superiore, Contrada Monte Serra Etna Bianco and Contrada Cavaliere Etna Bianco), so the range page was read before the product page as step 6 requires; the unqualified 'Etna Bianco' is the plain DOC bottling and is the right one. It gives Denominazione, altitude, Carricante in purezza, soil, vine age, planting density, yields, harvest timing, fermentation, ageing, a tasting note and a food pairing — and NO vintage, NO alcohol and NO pack. It could not have been vintage-matched even if a list had appeared on it. THE SCHEDA TECNICA IS PRE-OBLIGATION AND WAS NOT DOWNLOADED. Its URL carries no vintage (BENANTI-Scheda-Tecnica-Etna-Bianco.pdf) and a HEAD returns 'last-modified: Wed, 04 Oct 2023 18:10:49 GMT' — two months before 8 December 2023, so the file cannot carry a declaration under Regulation (EU) 2021/2117. Step 5, closing a wine without a download, for the second time in this batch. NO DECLARATION SURFACE ANYWHERE. Raw and stripped greps of the range page, the product page and the download page return zero for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia, dichiarazione, etichettatura, annata and every Italian vendor token (ioagri, ead-qr, i-wine, carmaqrcode, goalstec, u-label.com, btn-nutrizional, tab-ingredienti, qualita). FIRST, the site is WooCommerce — its sitemap index names productcat-sitemap.xml and producttags-sitemap.xml — and there is NO product-sitemap.xml, so the sitemap index alone would have suggested the estate has no wine pages; the 17 /prodotto/ URLs exist and are linked only from /vini/. That is the Rocca delle Macie lesson repeating, and it is the reason the range page was fetched. declarations.evidence: STEP 2 CLOSES IT. Systembolaget sells 'Susucaru Rosso' 2024, Sicily, 14,0 %, 75 cl. It could not have been vintage-matched even if a list had appeared. THE PACKAGING OBLIGATION IS PUBLISHED AND THE INGREDIENT ONE IS NOT — the third producer in this batch. The page ends with a 'HOW TO RECYCLE' block covering bottle, closure (Ardeaseal, natural cork, screw cap, olive oil pouring closure), wax cap, case and pallet, with the bin for each. declarations.robots_reasoning: gramona.com's robots.txt is a Yoast block whose only group is 'User-agent: *' with an EMPTY 'Disallow:', which allows everything. vinsperestimarelvi.com has TWO 'User-agent: *' groups — the first disallowing /wp-content/uploads/wpo/wpo-plugins-tables-list.json, the second a Yoast block with an empty Disallow. Under RFC 9309 groups naming the same token are merged, so the union disallows exactly that one JSON file; the wine pages and /docs/*.pdf are allowed. No exception was needed on either host.
declarations.evidence: Systembolaget sells 'Gessami Penedes' 2024, Catalonia, 11,0 %, 75 cl. The producer's page is for the right cuvee — GESSAMI, 'Muscat de Frontignan, sauvignon blanc i gewurztraminer', 'Vol. 11%', which matches Systembolaget's strength exactly — and STATES NO VINTAGE, so step 2 closes the wine: it could not have been vintage-matched even if a list had appeared. (The page's one pack statement, 'Disponible en 375 cl.', is a typo for 375 ml and does not describe Systembolaget's 75 cl item; it is noted, not relied on.) GRAMONA'S STILL WINES ARE ON A SEPARATE BRAND SITE, AND THAT IS THE STRUCTURAL FINDING. gramona.com is the Corpinnat sparkling house; its /coleccion/{wine}/ URLs for the still wines 301 out to VINSPERESTIMARELVI.COM ('vins per estimar el vi'), a small Catalan-first WordPress carrying six wines — Gessami, Mart, Mustillant blanc, Mustillant rosat, Vi de Glass and Ca la Mar — and footed '(c) 2021 GRAMONA, Tots els drets reservats' at Carrer Industria 36, Sant Sadurni d'Anoia. So the producer is right and the wine is right; they are simply not on the domain the producer's name suggests. **Follow the redirect: a Spanish house's still wines can live on a differently-named brand site.** BOTH SURFACES ARE UNDATED. The page gives Varietats, 'Vol. 11%', a 'Moment' paragraph and a link to the fitxa tecnica, and states NO vintage. THE FITXA TECNICA IS SPAIN'S FIRST, AND IT IS THE FRENCH FICHE AND THE ITALIAN SCHEDA AGAIN: Gessami's (docs/gessami_cat.pdf) was downloaded and its text extracted in full — Elaboracio, Sensacions, a Moment paragraph, an Ecologia i sostenibilitat paragraph, 'Varietats: muscat de Frontigan, sauvignon blanc i gewurztraminer' and 'Vol. 11%'. NO VINTAGE, NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO ENERGY VALUE. The one analytical number in it is 'els sis grams de sucre per litre residuals' — residual sugar, which is not an additive declaration. NO OTHER SURFACE EXISTS. gramona.com's sitemap index has four children and none is a product or shop type; its 52-page sitemap holds no shop, no botiga, no tienda and nothing declaration-shaped. Raw and stripped greps of both wine pages return zero for ingredient(e)s, ingredients, nutricional, valors nutricionals, sulfit, kcal, energia, alergen and every vendor token known to this project. ONE SIGN OF HOW MAINTAINED THE SITE IS, recorded because it bears on whether an absence is deliberate: the brand site's footer still contains the WordPress theme's demo content — '123 W 43rd ST, New York, NY', 'oraiste@qode.com', '(456) 5647-215' — beside the real Sant Sadurni address, and the copyright line reads 2021. This is a site nobody has revisited since before the obligation began.

declarations.evidence: THE PRODUCER'S OWN PRODUCT PAGE STATES TWO DIFFERENT VINTAGES, AND THAT IS THE THING TO CARRY FORWARD. Systembolaget sells 'Vivanco Blanco Rioja' 2024, Rioja, 13,0 %, 75 cl. But its URL slug ends -2025.html, its short description opens 'Botella sin estuche de nuestro Vivanco Blanco 2025', and its Descripcion tab is headed 'ANADA 2024'. THE SAME PAGE SAYS 2025 AND 2024. A run that matched on the slug would call this the 2025 and reject; a run that matched on the heading would call it our 2024 and attach. NEITHER IS SAFE, and under the rule that an uncertain vintage is a rejection rather than an approximation, nothing here could have been attached even if a list had been present. The likeliest reading is a PrestaShop product edited forward in the slug and metadata while the long description was left on the previous year — the inverse of the stale-title trap at wineplatform.it, where the title lagged and the H1 was current. RECOGNISE IT: on a PrestaShop, compare the slug, the short description and the description tab before trusting any one of them. IT DOES NOT DECIDE THE OUTCOME HERE, because there is no declaration on the page either way. What it carries is 'Grado alcoholico 13%. Contiene sulfitos.' and '75 cl.' in a four-bullet list — strength, allergen and pack. Those are physical-label particulars; there is no substance list and no energy value, so it is the Spanish form of the two-particular near-miss. THE SHOP IS THE ONLY SURFACE WITH A VINTAGE ON IT, AND IT HAS NO DECLARATION. The marketing site (vivancoculturadevino.es) presents the range by tier — Espumosos, Jovenes, Criados, Vivanco Brunes, Coleccion Vivanco, Vivanco La Isla — with no per-wine pages, no vintages and no declaration terms at all; its single `ingredien` hit is the phrase 'los ingredientes necesarios para este vino iconico' in a blog paragraph about winter fog, which is a new false positive worth naming. AND WHAT IT PUBLISHES WHERE THE INGREDIENT LIST BELONGS IS AT MOST TWO PARTICULARS. The white's bullet list reads 'Grado alcoholico 13%. Contiene sulfitos.' and '75 cl.' — strength, allergen and pack, which are label particulars and not a declaration; there is no substance list and no energy value. The rose does not even have that: a Spanish-term grep of its 153 kB (ingredient, nutricional, sulfito, sulfuroso, alergen, kcal, kJ, energetico, declaracion, conservante, antioxidante, etiqueta, e-label, u-label.com and every vendor token) returns ZERO on raw HTML and stripped text alike. declarations.robots_reasoning: www.raventos.com answers /robots.txt with a genuine HTTP 404 and a 196-byte Apache error body. A 4xx is RFC 9309 §2.3.1.3 Unavailable Status: no rules exist and the host is open. The shop is on the same host (/botiga/ and /store_site/), so one reading covers everything fetched. declarations.evidence: Systembolaget sells 'Raventos i Blanc De Nit' 2024, Catalonia, 12,5 %, 75 cl. Every part of the four-part check passes: the producer is Raventos i Blanc, the cuvee is De Nit (its rose sparkling, inspired by Billecart-Salmon Rose), the vintage 2024 is stated on the range page, in the URL, in the shop breadcrumb and as an 'ANYADA' heading, and the fitxa tecnica for the 2024 gives 'Grau alcoholic 12,40% vol' against Systembolaget's 12,5 — 0,1 pp, well inside tolerance — and '210.000 ampolles de 75 cL' confirming the pack. This is as clean an identification as Spain has offered, and there is nothing to attach to it. THE IDENTITY IS EXCELLENT ON EVERY SURFACE. Raventos i Blanc, Sant Sadurni d'Anoia, works in its own Conca del Riu Anoia denomination, and BOTH ITS SURFACES ARE PER-VINTAGE: the range page names each wine with its year in the anchor text and the URL (/colleccio/escumosos/145/de_nit_2024), and the shop repeats it in the breadcrumb, the H1, the slug and an 'ANYADA' heading. This is the best vintage control seen in Spain so far and among the best anywhere in this project. AND NEITHER SURFACE CARRIES A DECLARATION. A Catalan- and Spanish-aware grep of the marketing page, the range page and both shop pages (ingredient, nutricional, nutricio, sulfit, sulfur, lergen, kcal, kJ, energ, declaraci, conservant, antioxidant, etiqueta, e-label, elabel, u-label, and every vendor token) returns nothing but false positives: the one `kJ` hit on each shop page is inside a PHP-generated image filename (phpHKJGpR), the one `qr` hit is likewise (phpvWdQrT), `valor` is the cookie-banner JavaScript, and `etiqueta` is the sentence 'Data de desgorjat indicada a la contra etiqueta' — the disgorging date is on the back label, which is a statement about the bottle and not a disclosure on the page. THE FITXA TECNICA IS THE RICHEST NEAR-MISS THIS PROJECT HAS FOUND ANYWHERE, AND IT IS STILL NOT A DECLARATION. THIS MATTERS ENOUGH TO SPELL OUT. 'Fitxa Tecnica De Nit 2024' is a one-page datasheet, linked from the shop under its own heading, and it was downloaded and its text extracted in full. It is headed 'Nom del Vi: De Nit' and 'Anyada: 2024' and then gives about forty labelled fields, including several that name actual substances with doses: 'Sulfitat: 3,5 g/hL SO2', 'Clarificant: Bentonita a dosi de 3 g/hL', 'Sucre de tiratge: Sucre de canya certificat Ecologic', 'Licor d'expedicio: Vi base De Nit amb sucre Eco', 'Tractament pels fongs: ... 2,8 kg coure/ha ... sofre', and an Analisis block reading 'Grau alcoholic 12,40% vol / Acidesa total tartarica 6,0 g/L / pH 3,07 / Acidesa volatil 0,26 g/l / Sucres residuals 4,0 g/l Extra Brut / Sulfuros total 55 mg/L / Pressio 5,6 bars'. IT IS NOT AN INGREDIENT LIST AND MUST NOT BE TREATED AS ONE. Those substances appear as PROCESS PARAMETERS in a winemaking description — a dosing rate per hectolitre, a fining agent with its dose, a vineyard fungicide — not as the declaration Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 requires: there is no 'Ingredients' heading, no list, no allergen statement, no nutrition table and no energy value. Bentonite is in any case a processing aid rather than an ingredient. Assembling a declaration out of these fields would be exactly the invention CLAUDE.md forbids, and it would produce a different list from the one the producer would print. Recorded not_found. THE LESSON FOR THE NEXT RUN: a document can name more substances than a real e-label does and still not be one. The test is the form — a list of what is IN the wine — not the presence of substance words.

declarations.evidence: Producer and cuvee match exactly, and the chain is the producer's own: the URL was read off Campo Viejo's own product page for Winemakers' Blend, and the payload's commercialName is 'Campo Viejo Winemakers Blend' with the responsible company named as Vinarchy Spain S.A.U. (Campo Viejo passed from Pernod Ricard to Vinarchy in 2025; the e-label platform is still Pernod Ricard's). Market matches: the SE country file was fetched and it carries a Swedish-language rendering of the list. Alcohol matches exactly, 12,50 % on the e-label against Systembolaget's 12,5 — and note that the producer's own marketing page says 13.5 %, so the e-label is the current figure and the brochure text is stale, the Julg/Von Winning pattern again. The declaration itself is complete in form: a list of substances by role, with the allergen in capitals.
declarations.rejected_because: VINTAGE, and it cannot be established from anywhere. The platform is keyed on a liquidQualityCode — a code for the liquid, not for a bottling — and its payload contains no vintage, no year, no date and no lot field of any kind (the full key set was enumerated and there is not one). Campo Viejo's own product page states no vintage either. Systembolaget's item is the 2024. So nothing on the producer's surface says which year this list describes, and the platform's design means the same URL will silently serve a different recipe when the blend is rebuilt. This is the same close as 7626701, 7949701 and 5083501: the declaration states no vintage and the producer's own page states none either, so the source could equally describe a later bottling. A second, weaker objection: Systembolaget's item is a 3000 ml bag-in-box and the e-label states no pack, so the pack test cannot be run either.
declarations.robots_note: campoviejo.com allows everything (wildcard group, empty Disallow). e-label.pernod-ricard.com serves a robots.txt with named crawler groups only and no User-agent: * fallback; vindeklaration/… matches none of them, so under RFC 9309 and the project policy of 2026-08-08 no rule applies and nothing is disallowed. No e-label exception was needed or used.
declarations.elabel_platform: e-label.pernod-ricard.com — Pernod Ricard's own group-wide e-label platform, NEW TO THIS PROJECT. A Vite/Vue SPA whose data layer is plain static JSON on the same host, unauthenticated: /liquid-qualities/{code}/{code}.json for the liquid (name, alcohol, nutrition, per-country denominations) and /liquid-qualities/{code}/{code}_{CC}.json for the per-market display blocks, of which block 2 is the ingredient list. Codes are of the form L004YJ and are published by the brand's own site.

declarations.evidence: Producer and cuvee match exactly: Audentia is Murviedro's own range and there is exactly one Audentia Petit Verdot in a complete range index of about fifty wines. Pack matches (750 ml) and alcohol matches (13 % vol against Systembolaget's 13,0). The GTIN in the e-label URL, 08410388009410, is Murviedro's own and is published by Murviedro itself. What is missing is the ingredient list and the vintage.
declarations.not_found_because: THE DECLARATION EXISTS AND CANNOT BE READ. Murviedro splits the disclosure exactly the way Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 allows: the allergen ('Contiene Sulfitos') and the energy value ('E = 319 kJ / 76 kcal') are printed inline on the product page, and the ingredient list sits behind the QR — on SCANTRUST, which this project has established cannot be read by anyone, because the uid and api_key live in a URL fragment the server never receives. This is the THIRD Scantrust deployment tested and the SECOND test of its GS1 Digital Link path form: bmkp.st4.ch/01/{gtin}, with no lot segment, 302s into the identical 1 590-byte shell as eega.st4.ch/01/{gtin}/10/{lot} did. The path form is confirmed no more readable than the fragment form. The vintage is also unstated: the product page carries origin, variety, vinification and food pairing and no year of any kind, so even a readable e-label would have had to date itself. This is a rendering limit, not an absence — Murviedro has published a declaration and the platform its supplier chose makes it unreadable to anyone comparing two bottles.
declarations.robots_note: murviedro.es allows the product pages fetched. bmkp.st4.ch answers 'User-agent: *' / 'Disallow: /' and the e-label exception decided 2026-07-30 WAS USED for exactly one request: the URL was taken from Murviedro's own 'Consultar Ingredientes' anchor, nothing was traversed, no sitemap was read and no URL was guessed. It bought nothing, as the platform is unreadable regardless of permission.
declarations.elabel_platform: Scantrust, reached through the tenant host bmkp.st4.ch by its GS1 Digital Link path /01/{gtin}. FIRST SPANISH SCANTRUST DEPLOYMENT.

Mumm has published an e-label entry for Cordon Rouge and left it blank. Systembolaget sells Cordon Rouge under two product numbers, 7911201 at 750 ml and 7574010 at 6000 ml. THE TWO ARE NOT ASSUMED TO BE ONE BOTTLING: nothing on either surface says so. What can be said is that the producer's index lists 'Cordon Rouge' once, with no pack dimension, and that the platform is keyed on a liquid and states no pack at all — so the pack test cannot be run in either direction and neither wine is closed on pack. Both are closed on the same thing, an empty declaration. This record is the 750 ml item.

declarations.name: Perrier-Jouët Grand Brut
sources_checked: https://www.perrier-jouet.com/robots.txt — 403. The robots file itself is refused, so no directives could be read
https://www.perrier-jouet.com/ (403, 5 488 bytes) — the brand's own site refuses an identified request at the edge

https://perrier-jouet.com/en-ww/champagne-collection/grand-brut (403, 5 488 bytes, byte-identical length) — ONE fetch of the apex hostname, on a URL held from a public search index rather than guessed, to establish whether the refusal was specific to the www host. It is not: both hostnames refuse identically, and the host was not touched again
https://www.pernodricard.se/robots.txt — stock WordPress: wildcard group disallowing /wp-admin/ and allowing /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php. Nothing here is disallowed
https://www.pernodricard.se/sortiment/mumm-cordon-rouge/ (200) — six pack variations, 375/750/1500/3000/6000/9000 ml, EVERY ONE data-e-label=""
declarations.evidence: NOT AN IDENTITY FAILURE AND NOT AN ABSENCE — a refusal. Both wines are non-vintage (Systembolaget carries no vintage for either), so this is exactly the case where e-label.pernod-ricard.com's liquid-keyed declaration would have been exact rather than worthless, and the sister brand G.H. Mumm publishes its whole range's liquidQualityCodes on an index page at /{locale}/nutrional-information/. The same index almost certainly exists on perrier-jouet.com — a page titled 'Nutritional Information | Perrier-Jouët USA' at /en-us/nutritional-information is in the public search index. IT CANNOT BE READ: perrier-jouet.com answers 403 to an identified request, on the apex and the www host alike, and even its robots.txt is 403. A 403 is a technological refusal and is absolute under the project's rules: not retried, not worked around, no mobile User-Agent, no exception. The liquidQualityCode was therefore never obtained, and it will not be guessed — the platform's codes are opaque (L0047G, L01078) and enumerating them on the e-label host is exactly the traversal the robots policy forbids. This record is the 1500 ml item. SECOND ROUTE TRIED, AND IT ALSO CAME BACK EMPTY. The Swedish owner's own portfolio site, pernodricard.se, is readable (stock WordPress robots.txt, nothing relevant disallowed) and carries a page per product with a 'Näringsinfo' button whose href the theme fills from a data-e-label attribute. Grand Brut's page and Blanc de Blancs' page each carry exactly one variation and both have data-e-label="", as does every one of the six Mumm Cordon Rouge variations. Blanc de Blancs' variation also carries data-article="56155", which is Systembolaget's 5615501 without the pack suffix, so the Swedish page is demonstrably the same item. A PACK NOTE FOR GRAND BRUT: pernodricard.se lists only a 750 ml Grand Brut, while Systembolaget's 7650206 is the 1500 ml magnum. That does not change the outcome — there is no declaration to attach either way — but it is not a pack match and would have to be settled before any future find is attached to this product number.
declarations.robots_note: perrier-jouet.com's robots.txt is itself a 403, so no directives exist to honour or set aside. The stop here is the 403 on the pages, which is a technological measure and absolute — the e-label exception has nothing to do with it and was not considered.
declarations.blocked_by: HTTP 403 on the producer's own host, both www and apex
declarations.elabel_platform: Expected to be e-label.pernod-ricard.com (the brand is Pernod Ricard's and its sister brand G.H. Mumm is on it), but never reached: the brand site that would publish the code is refused.

declarations.name: La Bruja Vino Regional
sources_checked: https://www.comandog.es/ — the TLS handshake fails: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, 'EE certificate key too weak'. robots.txt could not be read either, and the probe correctly treated the unreachable robots.txt as a misconfiguration and proceeded, only to be stopped by the same TLS failure on the page
declarations.evidence: Nothing was read. THE STOP IS A TLS FAILURE THAT IS NOT COVERED BY EITHER SETTLED RULE and the run did not stretch them. The 2026-08-30 decision reopens a host whose certificate has EXPIRED, and only expiry: a self-signed certificate, an untrusted issuer or a hostname mismatch stays a hard stop because each is a claim about who answered. 'EE certificate key too weak' is a fourth thing — OpenSSL's security level rejecting the end-entity key as too short, which says nothing about identity and is, like expiry, a pure misconfiguration on the estate's side. It is arguably within the spirit of the expiry rule, but the rule as written names expiry alone, so the fetch was NOT retried without verification and the wine is closed as not found. THIS IS FOR THE OWNER TO DECIDE, not for an agent to widen on its own. Comando G is a well-known Gredos producer and the wine, La Bruja de Rozas, is squarely in the pool.
declarations.robots_note: No robots.txt could be read, because the same TLS failure prevents any request to the host. No robots question arises and no exception was used.
declarations.blocked_by: TLS: EE certificate key too weak (not expiry, so the 2026-08-30 unverified-retry rule does not reach it)

declarations.evidence: Producer and cuvee match: Adega Pazo do Mar is one of the three bodegas of Grupo Pazo Vinos de Galicia and Veiga da Princesa is its Rias Baixas albarino, published as the only wine on the group's Albarino page; Systembolaget's item is Veiga da Princesa Albarino from Galicien with Adega Pazo Do Mar in the producer field. THE E-LABEL POINTER IS THE PRODUCER'S OWN and it is Spain's GS1 Digital Link resolver: id.aecocescanqr.es/es/01/{GTIN}, run by AECOC, the Spanish GS1 member organisation, with GTIN 08437003930126 in the AI 01 segment. declarations.not_found_because: THE DECLARATION EXISTS AND IS BEHIND A TECHNOLOGICAL MEASURE. The producer has complied through electronic means exactly as Regulation (EU) 2021/2117 intends — a per-GTIN GS1 Digital Link, labelled 'Informacion nutricional e ingredientes', linked from the wine's own page — and the resolver answers 403 to us. _runs.result: 5 pages fetched, 0 declarations read; the Scantrust e-label renders client-side and its data sits behind a per-request issued token. No status changed. The 4 wines with no e-label URL were not touched.

_runs.batch: 2 — rendering reconnaissance across five producers in four countries (Billaud-Simon FR, Tommasi IT, Hain DE, Hällåkra SE, Vini Franchetti IT), 27 wines, all vintage 2024+ and not_declared
_runs.result: 27 attempted, 3 found, 23 not found, 1 rejected. VERDICT: server-rendered e-labels do exist. Weingut Hain's are plain HTML on the Winitas shop platform at {winery}.winitas-shop.de/elabel/{id}, with the ingredient list, nutrition table, allergens and Impressum in the server's response — no JavaScript, no token, no robots restriction. Client-side rendering is therefore not universal, contrary to the worry raised by Scantrust and IMERO. The dominant finding is nevertheless scarcity: four of the five producers publish no e-label and no ingredient list anywhere this run could see, so the binding constraint is that e-labels are rare and unlinked, not that they are unreadable.

THE FIRST BATCH WITH NO FIND AT ALL, and the reason is uniform: seven of the ten producers demonstrably publish a complete declaration, and in every case it is for a vintage other than the one on the Swedish shelf. Rejections: Richter Sonnenlay (only the 2025 declared), Richter Wehlener Sonnenuhr (right vintage, wrong cuvée — the feinherb at 9,5 % against our fruity Kabinett at 7,5), Wagner-Stempel (graphic-druck e-label naming itself the 2025), Paulinshof (Euvino shop rolled to the 2025 at 12 % against our 11,5), Hauck (Winestro e-label naming itself the 2025 at 13,0 against our 12,5 Spätlese). _runs.batch: 3f — the last of the German 2024-vintage undeclared pool, one commit per producer: Weingüter Wegeler, Weingut Hoffmann-Simon, Weingut Keller, Emrich-Schönleber, Spring Wine & Spirits / Weingut Mehrlein, Solera Sweden (2 wines), Rewine, Joh. Jos. Prüm. THE GERMAN 2024+ POOL IS NOW EXHAUSTED.
_runs.result: 9 attempted, 0 found, 8 not found, 1 rejected. THE REJECTION: Hoffmann-Simon, a complete self-identifying Winitas e-label for exactly this cuvée — Klüsserather Bruderschaft Riesling Spätlese trocken, Bio-Weintrauben, 322 kJ/77 kcal — naming itself the 2025 where the shelf holds the 2024; the Winitas one-request vintage census proved the 2024 is on no listing the estate publishes. THE NOT FOUNDS SPLIT THREE WAYS. (1) Producer found, current vintage on sale, no declaration published: Wegeler, whose Shopware shop has per-wine pages, per-vintage URLs and our exact 2024 at 12,0 % vol to the decimal, and links nothing but 'enthält Sulphite' — the clearest evidence yet that structure does not predict publication. (2) Estate with no searchable surface: Keller (a three-URL Wix brochure, from Gault Millau's Winzer des Jahrzehnts) and Prüm (a 3,7 kB contact card, third wine, re-fetched rather than assumed). (3) Importer in the producer field: four wines. Spring's Even & Odd was traced to Weingut Mehrlein via the agency's own 'Producent' field, and Mehrlein's site states outright that it vinifies exclusively for trade partners, so the cuvée has no page to begin with; Rewine's Robusta is absent from both of that importer's sitemaps; Solera's Pride and Phonetics are own labels whose estate could not be established at all, and nothing was guessed from the two German bottlers on Solera's producer list. ONE OUTAGE, RECORDED AS SUCH: emrich-schoenleber.de answered 503 on every content URL across three requests — an outage, not a refusal — and a German retailer carries what is very probably the producer's own text for our exact vintage and alcohol. It was not taken. A retailer's transcription cannot be allowed to outrank Systembolaget's in a file that outranks Systembolaget's. That wine is the strongest revisit candidate in the pool. WHAT THE WHOLE GERMAN POOL CAME TO: 89 wines across some 60 producers attempted, 18 declarations attached.

_runs.result: 12 attempted, 0 found, 9 not found, 3 rejected. THE COOPERATIVE HYPOTHESIS DID NOT HOLD: five co-ops (Turckheim, Pfaffenheim, Cellier des Dauphins, Les Quatre Tours, Vignerons Proprietes Associes) produced one declaration between them, and it was a vintage behind. BUT THE RUN FOUND TWO PLATFORMS. (1) ALLIANCE NUTRI, alliance-alsace.com/01/{gtin}/22/{variant} — the project's first GS1 Digital Link and its first third-party e-label vendor on a French producer's page, server-rendered, 11 EU languages including Svenska, honours Accept-Language, and states designation, sweetness, vintage, format and GTIN. Found via Cave de Turckheim's 'INGREDIENTS ET NUTRITION' button; rejected only because the shop had not rolled forward to our 2025. (2) VINCOD IS VIN.CO, and m.rhonea.fr and m.hugel.com are the same platform — images from cdn.vin.co, every short code mirrored at vincod.com. Its per-wine page carries a <select id=millesime> naming the code for every vintage back to 2007, so OUR vintage is reachable from the producer's own control, and the vintage page can link a true e-label at /{code}/n/{hash}/{lang} with lot number, labelled alcohol, ingredients and nutrition per 100 ml and per 125 ml. That corrects the earlier reading of Rhonea: the platform is capable of an ingredient list and Rhonea had not filled it in. TWO COMPLETE HUGEL DECLARATIONS FOR OUR EXACT 2024 BOTTLES WERE READ AND BOTH WERE REJECTED ON STRENGTH — 12 % vol against Systembolaget's 13,0 and 14 % vol against 13,0, each twice the 0,5 % vol tolerance and in opposite directions, so not a rounding artefact. The third Hugel, whose strength agrees exactly, is the one whose page carries no e-label link. Also first in this project: a GEOBLOCK — boutique.gustavelorentz.com answers 403 'This website is only authorised from France and Germany', treated as a technological measure and absolute.

_runs.batch: 3d — the Alsace 2024+ undeclared pool to exhaustion, plus the largest Alsace-headquartered brand owner and the largest single-producer cluster left in France. Dopff & Irion, Blanck Andre et ses Fils, SARL Etienne Simonis, Faller Henri et Luc, Les Grands Chais de France, Marc Morey — 14 wines.
_runs.result: 6 producers, 14 wines, 0 FOUND, 0 rejected, 14 not found. THE ALSACE ESTATE POOL OF 2024+ UNDECLARED WINES IS NOW EXHAUSTED — 13 wines, 8 producers — and only the two already known, Cave de Turckheim and Hugel, publish anything at all. ALSACE WAS NOT THE VEIN IT LOOKED LIKE: the two platform adoptions found there in batch 3c were the whole of it, and the four estates left behind them published nothing. What the batch established instead. (1) Dopff & Irion runs the same VINIUM framework as Pfaffenheim AND HAS THE SAME OWNER, so those are one observation and not two; unlike Pfaffenheim's, its marketing URLs redirect into the shop, so the whole deployment is server-rendered. (2) A NEW NEAR-MISS SHAPE at Etienne Simonis: 'sans levurage, sans collage, sans chaptalisation ni acidification' — a prose statement of what was NOT added, which is the negative of an ingredient list and is not one. (3) A PRODUCER CAN HAVE NO WEBSITE AT ALL: Vignoble Luc Faller, confirmed by DNS, by the Vignerons Independants register and by the official Route des Vins d'Alsace directory — and vins-faller.fr is a different estate in the same village, the sharpest sister-name trap yet. (4) The Grand Sud ingredient list IS in circulation, complete, on Carrefour, Openfoodfacts and vinello.eu, and was refused: a record in this file outranks Systembolaget's, so an unsourced list here would override a correct absence. (5) Marc Morey closed six wines in five requests — its sitemap has seventeen URLs, none of them a wine. ALSO SETTLED A TLS TRAP THAT WILL RECUR ACROSS THE WHOLE PROJECT: 'unable to get local issuer certificate' on groupegcf.fr is ISRG ROOT YR, Let's Encrypt's 2025 root, absent from both the Pi's ca-certificates and certifi. Fixed honestly by adding Let's Encrypt's own cross-signed root-yr-by-x1.pem, which chains to the already-trusted ISRG Root X1; no verification was disabled. Any future 'TLS failure' with that message is our trust store, not the producer.

_runs.result: 15 attempted, 2 FOUND, 13 not found, 0 rejected. BOTH HYPOTHESES FAILED AND THE FIND CAME FROM NEITHER. Elsewhere: Terlan is the second Italian producer with a real per-vintage archive and declares nothing on it (and its 2024 page sits behind a query string its robots.txt disallows, so it was not fetched); Koefererhof is a three-page Squarespace brochure with no per-wine page at all and an empty sitemap; Rottensteiner and LaVis are one page per cuvee edited forward with a scheda tecnica that is analysis and prose; Pranzegg's only documented vintage is 2021 and its datasheet's strongest line is Total SO2 35 mg/l; Marchesi di Barolo and Tenute Piccini both run the same wineplatform.it shop, which keeps one product per vintage with the vintage in the slug and prints 'Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia' where the ingredient list would be. Conservanti: solfiti'.
